Name: Affections of the Goddess
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies the following effects on Achilles- 1. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is reduced by 50%; if NP, 25%. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 3. Applies Debuff ResUp for 1◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 50%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: A goddess's favour: tougher, harder-hitting and curse-proof for a turn.
Lore: what it is: A blessing from his mother, the sea goddess Thetis, that raises all of Achilles' parameters by a rank except Mana and Luck.
Icon concept: A sea-mother's hand of water cupping a small bronze helm, droplets rising like pearls. A cupped curve around a dome. Guard blue water, bronze helm, gold pearls. Reads at 24px as: a blue cupped hand holding a dome.

Name: Akhilleus Kosmos: The Miniature World Enclosed by the Azure Sky
What it does (system): (Passive) Used when Achilles Moves when Unmounted. If Achilles intends to Move onto an occupied Panel, the Unit occupying said panel is forced to Move backward until Achilles stops Moving in that direction. If the Unit does not or cannot vacate those panels, that Unit is forcefully Moved to one of the panels to its sides, and receives damage equivalent to a Normal Attack from Achilles (Base Attack (STR) is used). (Non-damaging) Once, when Achilles or any allied Unit within a 2 panel area of himself is targeted/is within Range of an AoE Noble Phantasm of Rank A and above, Akhilleus Kosmos can be used. Negate all damage and effects of that Noble Phantasm in a 5x5 panel area around Achilles. After that, Akhilleus Kosmos is broken; all its effects are lost and cannot be used for the rest of the game.
In one line: Achilles' shield: shoves aside anyone in his path as he moves.
Lore: what it is: A defensive Bounded Field Noble Phantasm in the form of a shield said to be forged by Hephaestus, comparable to Rho Aias. It shows the world Achilles saw and can stop Anti-Fortress, Anti-Country and Anti-God attacks.
Lore: how it looks: A shield bearing the world he saw, with swirling ocean currents around its rim from the sea god.
Icon concept: A round bronze shield seen face-on, its face a tiny world of concentric rings, ocean currents swirling at the rim. A perfect disc with rings. Bronze and white-gold, guard-blue sea at the rim. Reads at 24px as: a ringed gold disc.

Name: Andreias Amarantos: Amaranth of the Brave
What it does (system): (Passive/Non-damaging) Heroism's Eternal Man. All damage received is reduced as follows- 1. Unit without Divinity: Receives 0 damage 2. Unit with E-Rank Divinity: All Total Damage received is reduced by 50% (halved). 3. Unit with D-Rank Divinity: All Total Damage received is reduced by 25%. 4. Unit with C-Rank Divinity and above: Receives normal damage. The effect of Andreias Amarantos is lost if Achilles' Heel is damaged.
In one line: Nearly invulnerable: only the divine can hurt him, and barely.
Lore: what it is: The immortality given by Thetis, which nullifies attacks, except those from enemies with Divinity at or above a certain rank. It vanishes if his heel is pierced.
Icon concept: An amaranth flower that never wilts, blooming from a bronze greave, its petals glowing. A flower atop a leg-shape. Crimson-violet amaranth, bronze greave, gold light. Reads at 24px as: a bloom on a stem.

Name: Diatrekhōn Astēr Lonkhē: Spear-tip of the Star Traversing the Skies
What it does (system): Meteor Spear (Non-damaging) Duel Field. Can only be used when Unmounted. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Achilles challenges the targeted Unit to a duel. The Noble Phantasm is only activated if the opposing Unit (player) agrees to the duel, and all conditions of the duel (including defeat) must be decided and agreed on by the two involved parties. When this Noble Phantasm is activated, Achilles and the opposing Unit are enclosed within a 5x5 panel area where they are standing on the game board. Then, both Units will continuously duel (Combat) until one Unit is 'defeated' as per the terms of the duel; and when the 'defeat' occurs, the NP is deactivated. No Units can enter the NP area or interfere with the duel, even with Command Spells; the involved Units are not allowed to leave the NP area until the defeat occurs as well. Also, Luck Check cannot be used by the involved Units; and all buffs and debuffs that were caused by Units not involved in the duel are negated for the duration of the duel. This Noble Phantasm cannot be used on Female Units and/or Units with at least 3 Parameters one Rank lower than Achilles'. Additionally, this Noble Phantasm cannot be used on the following 3 Servants: Hector, Chiron, Penthesilea. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Challenges one enemy to a sealed one-on-one duel, nobody else allowed in.
Lore: what it is: Usable once he dismounts from his chariot. It uses the long spear Chiron sent as a wedding gift, and builds a Reality-Marble-like arena for a one-on-one duel with a fellow Heroic Spirit.
Icon concept: A long spear planted in the ground at the centre of a ring of light, the ring a duelling arena. A vertical line in a ring. White-gold spear, crimson ring on night. Reads at 24px as: a spear in a circle.

Name: Dromeus Komētēs: Comet Form
What it does (system): (Passive) Runner Comet. Is only in effect when Unmounted. Has the following effects- 1. Has the effects of Passive 1 of Riding (Double Move). 2. The value of Evade rolls are reduced by 4.
In one line: On foot, he runs like a comet: moves twice and dodges far better.
Lore: what it is: Embodies the legend that he is the fastest of all heroes, letting him cross a vast battlefield in one breath unhindered. It requires exposing his heel, and is lost if the heel is pierced.
Icon concept: A runner's heel trailing a comet's tail of light. A sweeping arc behind a point. Agility teal tail, white-gold head. Reads at 24px as: a comet streak.

Name: Achilles' Heel
What it does (system): Whenever Achilles participates in a Combat Phase while Unmounted, the enemy Unit has a chance to Attack Achilles' Heel during its Attack (the player states whether the AU performs a Heel Attack or not). Achilles cannot Block Heel Attacks. If Achilles Failed to Evade the Heel Attack, the percentage chance of succeeding are as follows- 1. Attack from the Front: 0% 2. Attack from the Sides: 5% 3. Attack from the Back: 10% a) +5% if the AU's Agility is equal to or higher than Achilles'. b) +5% if the Attack was performed at a Range of 3 or higher. c) +5% if Combat was initiated by the AU (i.e. not a Counter Attack). d) −10% if the Attack was an AoE Attack. e) +10% if Achilles was Attacked from within the Fog of War. f) A Luck Check can be used to increase the success chance by 25%. If the AU's Heel Attack fails, Achilles successfully Evades the Attack. If it succeeded, Achilles receives damage that ignores all Defensive Buffs and damage reducing effects, and his Heel is damaged permanently.
In one line: His one weak spot: enemies can aim at his heel for a crippling blow.
Lore: what it is: His famous fatal weak point. It is the linchpin of Andreias Amarantos and Dromeus Kometes, and when it is pierced both Noble Phantasms disappear.
Icon concept: A bare heel pierced by a single arrow, a drop of crimson at the wound. A heel shape crossed by a line. Bone skin, crimson drop. Reads at 24px as: a heel with an arrow.

Name: Runner Comet
What it does (system): (Active) Can only be used when Unmounted and at the start of a Combat Phase. Restore 3 Agility, then applies N.Atk Up for that Turn, Normal Attack damage dealt is increased by 30%; and Crit DmUp for that Turn, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. Cannot be used if Achilles is affected by Skill Seal or NP Seal. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Bursts into a sprint: regains footing and hits harder and sharper this turn.
Lore: what it is: The wiki lists Runner Comet as the name of the Noble Phantasm triggered by stepping out of his chariot: the speed of the fastest hero, at the cost of exposing his heel.
Icon concept: Base: the Comet Form streak. Accent: a spearhead leads the comet, the tail flaring ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a comet with a point.

Name: Troias Tragōidia: Tempestuous Immortal Chariot
What it does (system): Troy's Tragedy. (Passive) Riding Attack damage is increased by 25%, does not affect NP. At the end of any Turn where Achilles Acts while Mounted, his Master loses 25 Health. (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. This NP is used in the form of a Riding Attack, with a distance of 13 panels. First restores X Agility and applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by X0%; if NP (X−1)0%; X=(the amount of remaining MOV Achilles has divided by 2). Deals 4x damage. Then, applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by Y0%, Y=number of Units successfully hit by this NP. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: His three-horse chariot: rams through foes, at a cost to his Master.
Lore: what it is: His three-horse chariot, two immortal horses from Poseidon and a third taken from a city. He tramples through battle at godspeed, and more speed means more damage.
Lore: how it looks: A three-horse chariot, described at top speed as a giant galloping lawnmower.
Icon concept: Three horses charging head-on, a chariot behind them, all trailing a storm. Three heads abreast. Bronze and white, storm-gold dust. Reads at 24px as: three heads in a row.

Name: Freezing Summertime
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Invuln for ⅓◈ Turns. 2. Applies BuffRemoval ResUp for ⅓◈ Turns, the chance of having buffs removed from herself is reduced by 100%. 3. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, Crit Chance is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: Turns untouchable for a moment, her buffs locked in place.
Lore: what it is: Viy's Mystic Eyes force targets to a halt. Turned on herself, it holds any incoming attack in place for a limited time.
Icon concept: A sun hat crusted with frost, ice crystals glittering in its brim. A wide brim shape. Ice-white frost on a sun-gold hat. Reads at 24px as: a frosted brim.

Name: Ice Block Launcher・Absolute Killer Baseball: Underthrow Freeze Sinker
What it does (system): Base Attack (STR) is used. Range+3 for the Combat Process. Has the Aim effect. Deals 3x damage with a 5% chance of inflicting Instakill for each panel between Anastasia and the DU. Ice damage. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns.
In one line: Hurls a curving ice ball from afar; the farther, the likelier it kills.
Lore: what it is: She hurls a lump of ice disguised as a snowball with a spin that gives it unlikely force, and Viy's Mystic Eyes bend its flight without slowing it.
Lore: how it looks: A lump of ice thrown like a snowball that curves in mid-air.
Icon concept: A baseball-sized lump of ice curving through the air, a frost trail behind it in a hooked arc. A ball on a hook. Ice-white and pale blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a white ball on a curve.

Name: Ice Bucket Challenge for You
What it does (system): Attack Skill. Range=2. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Deals Water damage. Then, has the following effects- 1. Has a 20% chance of inflicting Slow for 1◈ Turns. 2. Applies the 'Soaked' effect. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: Douses one foe in icy water: they're soaked and may be slowed.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A tipping bucket pouring a sheet of ice water. A trapezoid tipping, a sheet falling. Ice blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a tipped bucket.

Name: Rock Snowball
What it does (system): (Passive) Anastasia's Normal Attacks at a Range of 3 or higher have a 10% chance of inflicting Bleed for ½◈ Turns. *Remember kids, don't throw snowballs with rocks in them!*
In one line: Her long snowballs hide rocks and may leave foes bleeding.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A snowball cracked open to show a grey stone inside. A circle with a dark core. White snow, grey rock, a fleck of crimson. Reads at 24px as: a white ball with a dark centre.

Name: Shvibzik (Summer)
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 3 Luck. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 20%. 3. NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈+⅔◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: A playful charm: regains luck, hits harder, and readies her ultimate sooner.
Lore: what it is: The ability to produce and manipulate anything Anastasia considers summery. Such things are often of little use in combat.
Icon concept: A small snow-white doll in a sun hat, giggling, snowflakes bouncing around it. A small round figure. White and Luck violet sparkles. Reads at 24px as: a small white doll.

Name: Snegleta・Snegurochka: Summer Snow, Beautiful Drops of Hoarfrost
What it does (system): Dreaming Crater・Snow Maiden. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range+1 for the Combat Process. First, inflict Def Dwn (A) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 30%, and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. Then, deals 3.5x damage and inflicts Skill Seal for ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.
In one line: A summer snowstorm that weakens armour then crushes all caught in it.
Lore: what it is: Viy's Mystic Eyes briefly invert the seasons, and the energy that inversion generates is launched at the target.
Icon concept: Hoarfrost drops falling from a sun-bright sky onto a crater of snow. A crater bowl under falling drops. Ice white and sun gold. Reads at 24px as: a white bowl under drops.

Name: Full Acceleration: Spirit Eyes
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Aim for 1◈ Turns. 2. Applies Crit Up (Viy) for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance of Attacks which use Base Attack (MAG) is increased by 50%; if NP, 20%. 3. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30%. 4. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP Damage dealt is increased by 20%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Viy's eyes open wide: she aims true and lands deadly magic crits.
Lore: what it is: Viy's Mystic Eyes are altered to stay permanently active, creating a maelstrom of surrounding mana that favours Anastasia.
Icon concept: A huge eye opening in a wall of ice, its iris a frozen spiral. An almond eye. Pale blue iris, ice-white lid. Reads at 24px as: a blue eye.

Name: Swimsuit!
What it does (system): (Passive) All Total Water Damage taken is reduced by 50% including NP.
In one line: Beach-ready: water attacks hurt her only half as much.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A beach ball with a single wave splash curling over it. A circle under a curl. Sun gold and sea blue. Reads at 24px as: a ball under a wave.

Name: Watermelon Splitting Master
What it does (system): (Passive) When Anastasia performs a Normal Attack at a Range of 1 to 2 while inflicted with Blind, it does not have a chance of Missing; and instead it gains the Pierce & Ignore Def effects, also the DU's Evade roll is increased by 4 if it Evades the Attack. (Active) Used at the start of a Combat Phase when initiating an Attack. Anastasia gains Blind until the end of the Combat Process. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.
In one line: Blindfolded, she never misses up close and cuts straight through.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A watermelon split clean in two by a stick, a blindfold ribbon floating. A split circle. Verdant rind, crimson flesh. Reads at 24px as: a split green circle.

Name: Appreciation of the Arts
What it does (system): (Passive 1) When a NP with the 'Artistic' Attribute is used within a 3 panel area of this Unit, it has a chance of learning the True Name of that NP (the information of that NP is copied to your Notebook). (Passive 2) All damage taken from a NP with the 'Artistic' Attribute is reduced. Note: NP with the 'Artistic' Attribute would be any Noble Phantasm involving or related to artistic, literary, musical creations.
In one line: An art lover who can learn a nearby artistic ultimate's secrets.
Lore: what it is: Seeing a Noble Phantasm with artistic anecdotes gives Gilles a small chance of working out its True Name.
Icon concept: An ornate gilt picture frame with an eye painted inside it. A rectangle around an eye. Gold frame, Luck violet eye. Reads at 24px as: a gold frame with a dot.

Name: Agni Gandiva: Flame God's Yell
What it does (system): Cannot be used on the same Turn as Mana Burst (Flames), or if Mana Burst (Flames) is in Cooldown. Base Attack (STR) and Base Attack (MAG) combined (e.g. BA=325) is used, effect of Magic Resistance is halved. Range=7. Has the Aim effect. Deals 4x damage and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns on the DU. Fire damage. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns. When Agni Gandiva is used, Mana Burst (Flames) also enters Cooldown.
In one line: Looses a flaming arrow from very far away straight at one target.
Lore: what it is: The longbow Arjuna received from the fire god Agni. It looses flaming arrows that home in with missile precision thanks to his Clairvoyance.
Lore: how it looks: A longbow firing arrows wrapped in flame.
Icon concept: A great longbow drawn to full, the nocked arrow wrapped in flame. A tall bow arc with a horizontal line. Ember gold flame, dark bow. Reads at 24px as: a bow with a burning line.

Name: The Awarded Hero
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈+⅓◈ Turns. 2. Applies Regen for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, Health is restored by 15% of its maximum value at the end of his Turn, at the end of any Turn he Acts, and at the end of the Round. 3. Applies Area CritUp (Awarded) for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 10% for himself; and 5% for other allied Units within a 2 panel area of this Unit. 4. Applies NP Regen for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: The hero's rewards: heals over time and readies his ultimate sooner.
Lore: what it is: Represents Arjuna's lifelong good fortune: whatever he needs is given to him at the moment he needs it, so long as no active curse stands in the way.
Icon concept: A laurel crown resting on a bow, a soft green glow under it. A ring above an arc. Gold laurel, verdant glow. Reads at 24px as: a gold ring over an arc.

Name: Clairvoyance (Bowman)
What it does (system): (Passive) When Arjuna performs a Normal Attack at a Range of 3 or higher, the DU has a 90% chance of using Evade- when Evading. Otherwise, the Combat Process proceeds as normal. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 25%. 2. Applies Debuff Immune for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, does not affect Instakill/Death/Erase. 3. Applies Range Up (Clairvoyance) for 1◈ Turns, Range is increased by 1 panel, does not stack. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: An archer's eye: from range, his shots are much harder to dodge.
Lore: what it is: Superb long-range eyesight that sees past normal vision, even invisible targets. He also bends his own sense of time at the moment he looses an arrow.
Icon concept: An eye framed by a drawn bowstring, the arrowhead at the pupil. An eye with a line through it. Luck violet iris, gold arrowhead. Reads at 24px as: an eye on a line.

Name: Fated Rivals of the Mahabharata
What it does (system): (Passive) If Karna is in the opposing Faction and within Range of Arjuna, they will only Attack each other. Arjuna's Master can spend one Command Spell to negate this effect for 1◈ Turns, but it will only affect Arjuna.
In one line: If Karna is near, the two rivals fight only each other.
Lore: what it is: Karna was his older half-brother and fated rival, and the thought of him unsettled Arjuna like a mirror. Their enmity peaked at Kurukshetra, and Arjuna remains driven to settle it.
Icon concept: Base: two blades crossed, one of white fire and one of gold sun. Accent: Arjuna's blade is the white-blue fire one, held in front. Reads at 24px as: an X of two colours.

Name: Mana Burst (Flames)
What it does (system): (Active) This Skill is used when Arjuna performs a Normal Attack. For that Combat Process, Arjuna's Base Attack used is his BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (e.g. BA=325). Has a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns on the DU. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Fire Damage. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Roar of the Flame God.
In one line: Pours magic into his strike as flame: harder hit, may burn.
Lore: what it is: A skill that came with Agni Gandiva. It releases jet-like bursts of mana as propulsion for his arrows, so they pierce faster than a rifle shot.
Icon concept: Base: an impact burst of fire erupting from a strike. Accent: the fire is the white-blue of Arjuna's flame. Reads at 24px as: a flame burst.

Name: Pashupata: Raised Arm of the Destruction God
What it does (system): Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Arjuna's Range for 4x damage plus 100. Has a 30% chance of inflicting Death on the DU. For every Rank in Divinity the DU has, the chance of inflicting Death is increased by 10% (example: Divinity Rank C, 30% + 30% = 60%). Then, inflicts Def Dwn on all affected Units for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 40%. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: The Destroyer's weapon: wipes an area, and may kill gods outright.
Lore: what it is: A divine weapon given by Shiva that delivers Moksha, which is instant death, with higher Divinity making it likelier. Firing it without restraint would kill Arjuna himself.
Icon concept: A raised arm holding a trident-headed missile, a third eye opening behind it. A vertical arm and a three-pronged head. White-blue fire, crimson eye. Reads at 24px as: a trident over an eye.

Name: Roar of the Flame God
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Restores 3 Luck. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 3. Applies NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 20%. 4. Applies the 'Agni' buff for 1◈ Turns, 3 times, Normal Attacks deal Fire damage with a 30% chance of inflicting Burn for 1◈ Turns; does not apply to & is not consumed by Attacks used with Mana Burst (Flames). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Mana Burst (Flames).
In one line: Calls on the fire god: regains luck and hits very hard for a turn.
Lore: what it is: In FGO, it is Arjuna's EX skill that raises his own Arts, Buster and NP damage for 3 turns; the wiki gives only game effects.
Icon concept: A roaring flame shaped like an open mouth, rising from a bowstring. A flame with a gap. White-blue fire on night. Reads at 24px as: a white flame.

Name: Avalon (place in Master)
What it does (system): (Avalon, Method 2) Used on her Master, when Arturia is directly next to her Master and they are both in their Home Base. Arturia places [Avalon] inside her Master (this counts as Arturia giving the Item to her Master); both Arturia and her Master cannot Attack on the same Turn, and cannot Move after.
In one line: Places her holy scabbard inside her Master to guard them.
Lore: what it is: Avalon is the scabbard of Excalibur: it heals its wielder of any wound and halts aging. Invoked by True Name it raises a barrier that shuts out all physical interference.
Lore: how it looks: A scabbard that deploys a defensive barrier field.
Icon concept: Base: the Avalon scabbard. Accent: it sinks into an outline of a figure's chest, glowing. Reads at 24px as: a gold sheath entering a figure.

Name: Avalon (take back)
What it does (system): (Avalon, Method 2) Arturia reobtains [Avalon] from inside her Master, by the same process: directly next to her Master, both in their Home Base; neither can Attack on the same Turn, and neither can Move after.
In one line: Takes her holy scabbard back from her Master.
Lore: what it is: Avalon is the scabbard of Excalibur: it heals its wielder of any wound and halts aging. Invoked by True Name it raises a barrier that shuts out all physical interference.
Lore: how it looks: A scabbard that deploys a defensive barrier field.
Icon concept: Base: the Avalon scabbard. Accent: it rises out of a figure's chest toward a gauntleted hand. Reads at 24px as: a gold sheath leaving a figure.

Name: Avalon: The Everdistant Utopia
What it does (system): (Non-damaging) When Arturia is summoned, roll an eight-sided die. If an 8 is rolled, she is summoned with the [Avalon] Item. Can be used in two different methods- 1. Can only be used 8 full Rounds after the start of the game (i.e. from the 9th Round onwards). Used when Arturia or an allied Unit directly next to Arturia is Attacked. Negate all damage and effects of that Attack including NP, on the Unit who was Attacked. If it was an AoE Attack, this NP affects all Units within a 1 panel area of Arturia. Using this NP does not reduce her Master's Health as a cost. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns. 2. Placing it inside her Master: Avalon (place).
In one line: The everdistant utopia: an untouchable barrier, or a Master who heals.
Lore: what it is: The scabbard of Excalibur: it heals any wound and stops aging. Invoked by True Name it raises a Bounded Field that places the user in the land of the fairies, shutting out all physical interference.
Lore: how it looks: A scabbard that deploys a defensive barrier field.
Icon concept: Base: the Avalon scabbard. Accent: it unfolds into a barrier of countless gold-white petals, blue enamel at their roots. Reads at 24px as: a gold sheath in a petal ring.

Name: Charisma
What it does (system): (Passive) All damage dealt by other allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself is increased by 20 including NP. This effect is negated if this Unit has Atk Up (Charisma) or is inflicted with Skill Seal.
In one line: A king's presence: allies near her deal more damage.
Lore: what it is: An innate talent for commanding an army that raises the morale and abilities of the forces under her command.
Icon concept: A gold crown with a single raised banner behind it. A crown under a vertical flag. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold crown.

Name: Dragon's Reactor Core
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. 2. Applies NP DmUp for ⅓◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is increased by 30%. 3. Applies the DRC buff for the rest of the Round at the end of the Turn this Skill used, all damage dealt by Normal Attacks is increased by 25%. Normal Attacks performed with Mana Burst are not affected by the DRC buff. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Mana Burst.
In one line: Her dragon heart roars: a huge surge in damage for a moment.
Lore: what it is: Listed as the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Mana Burst, which pours mana into her weapon and body and releases it in an instant burst.
Lore: how it looks: Mana Burst is described as filling the area with light and surging through the weapon.
Icon concept: A glowing heart-shaped reactor of dragon scales pulsing with blue-white light. A rounded diamond with a core. White-gold core, guard blue scales. Reads at 24px as: a bright core in a diamond.

Name: Excalibur: Sword of Promised Victory
What it does (system): (Passive) When Invisible Air is deactivated, Arturia's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance of dealing 25 extra Light damage to the DU, 50 if the DU has the 'Dark' Attribute. (Active) Can only be used when Invisible Air is deactivated. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x6 or 6x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Arturia for 4x damage plus 200. Has a 40% chance of inflicting Blind for 1◈ Turns. Deals extra damage to Units with the 'Dark' Attribute, damage dealt is further increased by 100%. Light damage. Then, Excalibur's NP Cooldown is reduced by X◈ Turns, X being (the number of Units affected by this NP * ⅓). Cooldown: 7◈+⅔◈ Turns. After Excalibur is used, Invisible Air is deactivated for 2◈ Turns after its use.
In one line: The sword of promised victory: a great beam of light down a line.

Lore: how it looks: A sword of light that fires a massive beam from its tip.

Name: Instinct
What it does (system): (Passive 1) When this Unit is Attacked, it has a 70% chance of automatically Evading the Attack. If Instinct fails, the Combat Process proceeds as normal. If the Attack is a Noble Phantasm, the chance is 35% instead. (Passive 2) Crit Chance is increased by 10%. This Skill is negated while inflicted with Skill Seal.
In one line: Sharp instinct: often dodges attacks before they land.
Lore: what it is: A sixth sense close to precognition that picks the best course of action in combat, predicts projectile paths, and ignores sight and sound interference.
Icon concept: A single eye closed, a bright line of foresight crossing in front of it. A closed lid and a line. Agility teal line, bone ink lid. Reads at 24px as: a closed eye and a slash.

Name: Invisible Air: Bounded Field of the Wind King
What it does (system): (Passive/Activation) Can be activated or deactivated at any time, once per Turn. When Arturia is summoned, she starts the game with Invisible Air active. Has the following effects while Active- 1. Whenever Arturia performs a Normal Attack and the DU Evades, the DU's Evade roll is increased by 1 if its AGI Rank is higher than Arturia's, and is increased by 2 if its AGI Rank is equal or lower than Arturia's. 2. The magnitude of Crit Dwn is halved on Arturia. If Invisible Air is deactivated while Arturia is affected by Crit Dwn effects, the magnitude of the Crit Dwn effects are un-halved.
In one line: Wind hides her sword: harder to read and to dodge while it lasts.
Lore: what it is: A barrier of layered wind that bends light around her sword, hiding its length and path. The compressed wind can be released as a one-shot projectile.
Lore: how it looks: The sword is wrapped in whirring wind that refracts light, rendering it nearly invisible.
Icon concept: Base: a sword wrapped in swirling wind, its blade invisible, only the hilt seen. Accent: Arturia's hilt is gold and blue. Reads at 24px as: a hilt in a swirl.

Name: Knight of Utopia
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself with the 'Round Table' Attribute, all damage dealt is increased by 20%; if NP, 10%. 3. Applies Dmg Boost (Utopia) for 1◈ Turns to herself- After Arturia performs 3 Attacks, her next Normal Attack deals 200% extra damage, then this buff is removed. 4. Applies the Utopia buff for 1◈ Turns to herself, whenever Arturia performs a successful Attack, NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns for every Unit successfully hit by that Attack. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Lore: what it is: Listed as the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Charisma, her gift for leading armies.
Icon concept: A raised sword crossed with a banner bearing a red dragon. A vertical blade beside a flag. Gold, white and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a blade and a flag.

Cannot be used on the same Turn as Dragon's Reactor Core.
In one line: Pours magic into a strike: a much heavier blow.
Lore: what it is: Infuses mana into the weapon and body, then releases it at once for reinforcement, sword technique, defence and movement.
Lore: how it looks: It fills the area with light and makes the weapon surge with energy.
Icon concept: Base: an impact burst of mana erupting from a strike. Accent: Arturia's burst is blue-white with a gold rim. Reads at 24px as: a white burst.

Name: Radiant Road
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Reduce Arturia's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns. 2. Apply S.Crit Up to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Arturia for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 3. Apply the Radiant buff for 1◈ Turns to herself, all other allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself gain the effects of her 'Instinct' Skill. Icon concept: A shining road of light leading to a distant gold star. A tapering path to a point. White-gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold path.

Name: Strike Air: Hammer of the Wind King

Name: Monstrous Strength

Lore: what it is: Given to those born monsters rather than fallen heroes or gods, it is the source of his inhuman Strength and Endurance.
Icon concept: A bull's horned skull crowned with dark fire. A wide horned shape. Bone and crimson-black. Reads at 24px as: a horned shape.

Lore: what it is: Avalon is the hallowed scabbard of Excalibur and the embodiment of the utopia King Arthur seeks, stolen from her before the Battle of Camlann.
Lore: how it looks: A luxurious gold scabbard with blue enamel, more crown-like than weapon-like.

Lore: how it looks: A large venomous horned snake with two forelegs breathing poison.
Icon concept: A horned serpent's head breathing a cone of violet flame. A head and a widening cone. Violet poison fire on night. Reads at 24px as: a violet cone.

Applies Atk Up (Charisma) for 1◈ Turns to this Unit, all damage dealt by allied Units within a 2 panel area of it is increased by a percentage; a smaller one if NP.
In one line: A leader's presence: allies nearby deal more damage.

Icon concept: A gold crown with a single raised banner behind it. A crown under a vertical flag. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold crown.

Name: Antares Snipe: Heavenly Scorpion Single-Shot
What it does (system): (Active) Can only be used at Night; and can only be used once per Night Round. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range=5. First, removes all Defensive Buffs from the DU, then deals 2x damage plus 100; then inflicts Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 40%. Damage dealt to Units with the [Earth] Attribute is further increased by 150%. When this NP is used, Chiron's Master loses Health equivalent to if a Rank E Noble Phantasm was used instead. If possible, this NP can be used to target a specific 'body part' or 'weak point' on the DU (i.e. Unit with the 'Vital Spot' Attribute); if used in this way, the chance of hitting that specific target is increased by 75%. Note: Can only be used during 'Night' Rounds as dictated by the game state (not from 'Night' created by effects such as 'Darkness' Terrain). Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. (Trigger) Automatically activates when Chiron is defeated. ⅓◈ Turns after Chiron was defeated, the Active effect of Antares Snipe is automatically used on the Unit who defeated him at the start of the Turn. Chiron's ex-Master does not lose Health from this effect. If ⅓◈ Turns after Chiron was defeated is a Day Round, then this effect automatically activates at the start of the next Night Round.
In one line: At night, a starlight arrow strips one foe's defences and strikes.
Lore: what it is: A tracking sniping Noble Phantasm that fires a shining star and needs no True Name or mana to start. It lacks power, so it must kill in one shot; it fires on its own a turn after his death and recharges only the next night.
Lore: how it looks: A shining star shot as an arrow.
Icon concept: A single star in the scorpion constellation loosed as a shining arrow. A star with a long tail. White-gold on starry night. Reads at 24px as: a shooting star.

Name: Clairvoyance
What it does (system): (Passive 1) When Chiron uses a Normal Attack at a Range of 3 or higher, the DU rolls a ten-sided die. The DU has a 90% chance of using Evade- when Evading. Otherwise, the Combat Process proceeds as normal. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 35%. Also applies Range Up (Clairvoyance) for 1◈ Turns, Range is increased by 1 (does not stack). Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. (Passive 2) Whenever Passive 1 of this Skill is triggered, reduce the Cooldown of this Skill by ⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Far-sight: shots from range are much harder to dodge.
Lore: what it is: Good eyesight that tracks distant targets by improving moving-target vision. Paired with his Eye of the Mind it gives limited glimpses of the future.
Lore: how it looks: A glow around his eyes when used in the Siegfried and Frankenstein fight against Achilles and Atalanta.
Icon concept: An eye glowing with a star in its pupil. An almond with a spark. Luck violet glow. Reads at 24px as: an eye with a star.

Name: Consecration of Eternal Life
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of Chiron. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 50%; and applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. Then, Chiron's Health is reduced by 5% of its maximum value (cannot drop below 1 in this way). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Blesses nearby allies: they crit more often and harder.
Lore: what it is: Recalls the legend of Chiron offering up his immortality and being raised to the heavens as the constellation Sagittarius, a protector of people against the Scorpion. In FGO, it raises party critical damage and gains stars, with a self-damage risk.
Icon concept: A centaur's hand raising a laurel wreath over a group, gold light spreading. A ring over an arc. Gold on night. Reads at 24px as: a gold wreath.

Name: Eye of the Mind (True)

In one line: Battle-honed insight: dodges better and recovers the skill as he does.
Lore: what it is: Insight born of training: he calmly reads the opponent and his own predicament, and reasons a way out through combat.
Icon concept: A calm eye with lines of motion bending away from it. An eye in parting lines. Agility teal on night. Reads at 24px as: an eye with curved lines.

Name: Great Sage of Centaurs
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn, Chiron switches between Human Form and Centaur Form. Can only be used once per Round. (Passive) In Centaur Form, MOV is increased by 2, but value of Evade Rolls are increased by 2. Additionally, Chiron gains the 'Passenger Seat' ability and loses the 'Humanoid' Attribute while in Centaur Form. Counts as only Moving one Unit. Can be combined with Riding Attack.
In one line: Shifts between man and centaur: faster, but easier to hit.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A centaur's silhouette mid-gallop, a bow on its back. A four-legged figure with a torso. Bone ink with gold light. Reads at 24px as: a centaur silhouette.

Name: Wisdom of Divine Gift
What it does (system): When Chiron is Summoned, he is given a list of Skills (preferably Rank B to Rank A) that must have an Active effect, of all other Servants on the field. He can then select three of them, and use their effects as effects of this Skill. Rank EX Skills cannot be copied. Neither can Skills a Servant is physically born with, Skills that are part of their body, or Skills unique to the Hero — Natural Body, 'Mystic Eye' Skills, 'Mana Burst' Skills, Kishu no Ma, Affections of the Holy Grail. Each copied Skill: Cooldown 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if another copied Skill is on Cooldown.
In one line: The great teacher copies three skills from other heroes in the battle.
Lore: what it is: The many kinds of wisdom granted by the Greek gods, letting him show almost any skill of B to A rank. With his Master's permission he can also grant skills to other Servants.
Icon concept: An open scroll with three glowing seals copied onto it. A scroll with three marks. Bone parchment, gold seals. Reads at 24px as: a scroll with three dots.

Name: Wisdom of Divine Gift (Teach)
What it does (system): Chiron is able to teach one of the copied Skills to another Servant. Both Masters must agree to this teaching, and both Chiron and the learning Servant must be directly next to each other. The teaching process lasts for 1◈ Turns; Chiron and the learning Servant cannot Act until the teaching process is complete, and the teaching process is cancelled if interrupted (e.g. enemy Servant Attack).
In one line: Teaches one of his copied skills to an ally beside him.
Lore: what it is: The same Wisdom of Divine Gift: he can bestow skills on other Servants with his Master's permission.
Icon concept: Base: the three-seal scroll. Accent: one seal lifts off it toward an open hand. Reads at 24px as: a scroll and a dot rising.

What it does (system): Ansuz. Damage Spell. Range=3. Deals damage to an enemy Unit and has a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.
In one line: Draws a fire rune that blasts a foe and may set them burning.
Lore: what it is: Ansuz is one of four runes (Algiz, Nauthiz, Ansuz, Ingwaz) carved in the seal of his four-branch arena. The page describes rune magecraft generally, not Ansuz's fire effect.

Name: Gáe Bolg: Barbed Spear that Pierces with Death
What it does (system): {M} Range=3. Base Attack (STR) is used. Has the Aim effect. When this NP is used, the DU performs a Luck Check. If Failed, the DU is inflicted with Instakill and Curse (Bolg). If the Luck Check succeeded or Instakill was not inflicted, this NP deals 3.5x damage and inflicts Curse (Bolg). Curse (Bolg) is separate from normal Curse, does not stack, and is Unremovable; when Cú Chulainn is defeated, Curse (Bolg) is removed from all affected Units. In one line: A cursed spear that strikes the heart first; the unlucky die outright.
Lore: what it is: A melee technique where causality is reversed, so the heart is pierced before the thrust lands.
Icon concept: A crimson spear curving back on itself, its barb already at a heart. A curved line ending at a dot. Crimson spear on night. Reads at 24px as: a red hook.

Name: Gáe Bolg: Soaring Spear that Strikes with Death
What it does (system): {R} Range=4. BA(STR) and half of BA(MAG) combined (e.g. BA=200) is used. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Range for 3.5x damage plus 100. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns. Note: cannot be used if Barbed Spear that Pierces with Death is on Cooldown.
In one line: Hurls the cursed spear skyward to rain down on a wide area.

Lore: how it looks: A two-meter crimson spear thrown from the sky that splits into many darts.

What it does (system): (Passive 1) Allows the use of Thaumaturgy Spells. (Passive 2) Whenever EMIYA uses a Thaumaturgy Spell, apply Range Up (Hawkeye) (Hawkeye) for 1◈ Turns, Range is increased by 1. Does not stack, but duration is extended if reapplied.
In one line: Can cast spells, and each one extends his reach.
Lore: what it is: Orthodox magecraft of unremarkable spells learned in life, including reinforcement and structural analysis.
Icon concept: A magic circle forming in an open palm. A ring above a hand. Mana blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue ring.

Name: Projection - Kanshou & Bakuya: Overedge
What it does (system): Attack Skill. During the Combat Process this Skill is used, the effects of 'Kanshou & Bakuya' extend to Normal Attacks at a Range of 3 or lower. EMIYA performs 2 Normal Attacks in a row, damage dealt by each Normal Attack is increased by 50%. Counts as EMIYA's Attack for the Turn. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. Categorized as Noble Phantasm. The effect of 'Kanshou & Bakuya' is negated while this Skill is on Cooldown.
In one line: The twin swords grow into wings: two strong strikes in a row.
Lore: what it is: Kanshou and Bakuya are the paired swords EMIYA habitually projects. In FGO his projection magecraft can make projected Noble Phantasms explode, momentarily raising their destructive power (Overedge).
Icon concept: Base: the black-and-white twin swords. Accent: their blades lengthen into wing-like edges. Reads at 24px as: a winged X.

Name: Thaumaturgy: Projection Magic
What it does (system): (Passive) A Skill which is the basis of his Noble Phantasms. 'Projection' Skills and NP cannot be used and have no effects if EMIYA is inflicted with Silence. Note: 'Projection' Skills and NP are treated as Thaumaturgy Spells.
In one line: The magic that copies weapons; silenced, he can't use it.
Lore: what it is: Magic that reproduces tools from his mental image for several minutes, rising sharply in rank for swords. It lets him prepare counterfeits and detonate them as Broken Phantasms.
Lore: how it looks: Shown as swords and dual blades such as Kanshou and Bakuya being generated.
Icon concept: A sword half-drawn in glowing wireframe, its circuits lit. A blade in outline. Mana blue lines on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue wire blade.

Name: Thaumaturgy: Reinforcement
What it does (system): Spell. Used at the start of a Combat Phase. During this Combat Phase, Normal Attack damage dealt is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns.
In one line: Strengthens his weapon by magic for one fight.
Lore: what it is: Magic that analyses an item's structure to find its flaw and repair or strengthen it.
Icon concept: A blade with blue circuit lines running along it. A blade with a glow. Mana blue on steel. Reads at 24px as: a blade with blue lines.

Name: Projection - Rho Aias: The Seven Rings that Cover the Fiery Heavens
What it does (system): (Non-damaging) Used when any allied Unit (including EMIYA) within a 3 panel area of EMIYA is about to be hit by a Noble Phantasm. EMIYA projects Rho Aias to protect the allied Unit(s) from the Noble Phantasm. Rho Aias has 1400 Health, and it will take the damage of the enemy's NP. For every 200 Health Rho Aias loses, EMIYA loses 100 Health. If the AU's NP deals more than 1400 damage, the remaining damage is dealt to the DUs accordingly. However, if the NP is a 'thrown weapon', Rho Aias' Health cannot drop below 1. EMIYA's Health cannot drop below 1 due to Rho Aias being damaged by the AU's NP. Additionally, all Units within a 3x3 panel area around the Unit Rho Aias is protecting also receive the effects of Rho Aias. EMIYA's Master loses Health equivalent to if an EX Rank NP is used. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns, and EMIYA's Health must have been restored back to above half its maximum value at least once since the last usage. Every time Rho Aias is used after its first usage, its Health is restored by half of its current Health.
In one line: Raises a seven-petal flower shield that blocks an ultimate attack.
Lore: what it is: The shield of Aias, an absolute defence against projectile weapons that takes heavy mana to manifest in layers.
Lore: how it looks: Translucent pink flower-like petals that block attacks.
Icon concept: Seven translucent pink petals opening in front of a hand. A rose of overlapping panes. Pink light on night. Reads at 24px as: a pink flower.

Name: Trace, On
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. If this is not the first time EMIYA has used this Skill in this game, reduce his Health by 5% of its maximum value (cannot drop below 1 in this way). 2. Apply one of the following effects of your choice to EMIYA- Activated Circuits (AC) or Blazing Circuits (BC). 3. Max and current Luck are increased by 5. 4. Restores 5 Agility. 5. Applies Atk Up (Trace) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. If EMIYA uses a Thaumaturgy or Projection Skill/NP while he has the Atk Up (Trace) buff, its duration is extended by ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns. If this Skill is used while EMIYA already has the Atk Up (Trace) buff, its duration is extended instead of stacking. Then, you can choose to swap from AC to BC or vice-versa. Note: EMIYA cannot have both the AC and BC effects at the same time.
In one line: Copies a weapon for a chosen boost, at a growing cost to himself.
Lore: what it is: The page lists Trace On as the EX Circuit Connection upgrade of his projection magecraft, where his magical circuits link to replicate blades.
Lore: how it looks: Shown as magical circuits connecting as blades are replicated.
Icon concept: Circuit lines lighting up a forearm as a blade forms in the hand. A diagonal arm ending in a blade. Mana blue and gold. Reads at 24px as: a blue line ending in a blade.

Name: Thaumaturgy: Tracing
What it does (system): Spell. Used during your Turn. Reduce the Cooldowns of 2 different Skills or NP with 'Projection' in its name by 1◈ Turns OR reduce the Cooldown of a Skill/NP with 'Projection' in its name by 2◈ Turns. Then, apply Dmg Boost for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30 including NP. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: Recharges his copied weapons and sharpens the next one.
Lore: what it is: Duplicating a weapon down to its components almost perfectly while reading the wielder's skill.
Icon concept: Two hourglasses with sword-shaped sands. Two upright shapes. Mana blue and gold. Reads at 24px as: two hourglasses.

Name: Unlimited Blade Works: Infinite Creation of Swords
What it does (system): Rank: E~A++ (Passive) At the end of every Combat Phase involving EMIYA, he gains 1 Aria. Maximum number of Aria stored is 6. EMIYA cannot gain Aria if he is inflicted with Silence. Silence stops only that: with 6 Aria he can open it while Silenced (ruled 2026-10-14). (Activation) Can only be used by consuming 6 Aria. Affects a 7x7 panel area around EMIYA. All Units within that 7x7 panel area are trapped and unable to leave; Units outside are unable to enter. Within Unlimited Blade Works, EMIYA's Base Attack (STR) is increased by 50. At the start of every Turn, all enemy Servants within Unlimited Blade Works perform an Evade roll. If failed, that Unit receives (25 x 1d4) STR damage; this damage is not affected by any damage modifying effects on EMIYA. Lasts for 2◈ Turns. Enemy Units outside Unlimited Blade Works are unable to Attack Units inside it and vice versa. EMIYA's Master loses Health equivalent to if a B Rank NP is used. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns.
In one line: Chants a reality of endless swords that rain down on the field.
Lore: what it is: An Innate Bounded Field (Reality Marble) that stores thousands of weapons, mostly copied Noble Phantasms he has seen, to wield or fire in barrages.
Lore: how it looks: A steel-mill world of weapons, flames and giant gears.
Icon concept: A wasteland of countless swords planted in the ground under giant gears in a red sky. Many vertical lines under a gear. Crimson sky, steel swords. Reads at 24px as: a field of spikes under a gear.

Name: Fae Contract
What it does (system): (Passive) Debuff Resist is increased by X%. Chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by X%. B+: X = 5. A: X = 10, and it also affects Instakill, Death and Erase.
In one line: A fairy's contract: lands curses more often and resists them better.
Lore: what it is: Anastasia's contract with Viy; contracts for wearing swimsuits are handled separately.
Icon concept: A tiny contract scroll sealed with a frost-flower seal, fairy dust around it. A small scroll with a seal. Ice white and Luck violet. Reads at 24px as: a small sealed scroll.

Name: Blasphemy Aesthetic

Inflicts NP DmDwn for 1◈ Turns, NP damage dealt is reduced by 20%. 2. Inflicts Def Dwn (A) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 10%; and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn (B) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 10%; if NP, 20%. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.
In one line: His profane art weakens the ultimates of foes before him.
Lore: what it is: The page lists Appreciation of Blasphemy as the Grand Order upgrade of his Appreciation of the Arts.
Icon concept: An inverted holy icon smeared with dark paint. A cross upside down. Violet and crimson on night. Reads at 24px as: an inverted cross.

Name: Evil Gaze of the Abyss
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all enemy Units within a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gilles. Has the following effects- 1. Inflicts Terror for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, chance of being inflicted with Stun from Terror is 40% (40% Terror). 2. Inflicts Curse. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%. 4. Applies Dmg Up (Curse) for 1◈ Turns to himself, all damage dealt to Units inflicted with Curse is increased by 30%. 5. Applies the Gazing buff for 1◈ Turns to himself, Normal Attacks inflict Curse; while Normal Attacks from all Horrors within a 2 panel area of himself have a 50% chance of inflicting Curse. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: A gaze from the abyss terrifies foes in front of him.
Lore: what it is: His eyes changed after he looked into the abyss and it looked back, becoming a source of fear that brings the target's own fear of the unknown to the surface.
Icon concept: Bulging eyes opening in a black void. Two round eyes in darkness. Violet-white eyes on night. Reads at 24px as: two eyes in black.

Name: Prelati's Spellbook: Gigantic Horror
What it does (system): Only usable when Gilles' Health is less than 25% of its maximum value. Has a 10% chance of automatically activating when Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed, or when Gilles is defeated without Prelati's Spellbook being destroyed. Transforms himself into a Gigantic Horror. Replace Gilles with the Gigantic Horror, and its new Stats are as follows- Health: 2000. Agility: 0. Luck: Same as Gilles. MOV: 0. Range: 3 panels, 3x3 panel area. Base Attack (STR): 200 (Used when Range<3). Base Attack (MAG): 200 (Used when Range>2). Sustainability: None. Attributes: Dark (Outsider), Large. Detect: Same as Range. When Gilles turns into the Gigantic Horror, its Stats are fully restored to its new values. Territory Creation and Mental Pollution become inactive; Blasphemy Aesthetic is unusable. When Summoning is used, the number of Horrors summoned is doubled. Evil Eye of the Abyss now hits a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to itself. The Gigantic Horror is no longer controlled by Gilles' Master, and Command Spells have no effect; instead the Gigantic Horror takes its Turn during the GM's Turn (i.e. the last Turn of the Round). When the Gigantic Horror Attacks, it always Attacks the nearest Unit. If there are no Units within its Range for 1 full Round, its Range will increase by 1 at the start of the next Round until it has Attacked a Unit, then it will reset.
In one line: At death's door, he becomes the heart of a colossal horror.
Lore: what it is: A massive evil god from another world, his strongest summon, with huge size and regeneration that withstands several Noble Phantasms.
Lore: how it looks: A massive Lovecraftian beast with Gilles at its center.
Icon concept: A towering mass of tentacles with a small figure at its core. A mound of curling lines. Violet-black, a crimson core. Reads at 24px as: a mass of tendrils.

Name: Item Construction
What it does (system): See Prelati's Spellbook.

Name: Prelati's Spellbook: Textbook of the Sunken Spiral Castle
What it does (system): (Passive) The basis for all of Gilles' Spells. Whenever Gilles is Attacked, if the AU's AGI Rank is Rank C or higher, it can instead target Prelati's Spellbook. The options Gilles has are as follows 1. Evade: If Gilles fails to Evade, he has a 20% chance of taking the damage instead of Prelati's Spellbook; otherwise Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed. 2. Block: Gilles takes the damage instead of Prelati's Spellbook. 3. Substitution: If Summoning: Horrors, Summoning: Elder Horror, or Prelati's Spellbook's Active effect is not on Cooldown, choose one of them, it enters Cooldown. If Gilles does this, instead of receiving the Attack, he can Move up to 4 panels; then roll a four-sided die, he summons that number of Horrors around the panel he was previously standing on, with at least one Horror standing on the panel he previously occupied, which is also the Horror that receives the AU's Attack. 4. Luck Check: If successful, Prelati's Spellbook is not destroyed. Can be used after a failed Evade (1). When Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed, Gilles can no longer use Summoning: Horror, Summoning: Elder Horror, or Prelati's Spellbook's Active effect; and all Horrors on the board are immediately destroyed. However, when Prelati's Spellbook is destroyed, Gilles has a 10% chance of transforming into the Gigantic Horror. When Gilles is defeated and Prelati's Spellbook is not destroyed, he has a 10% chance of transforming into the Gigantic Horror. Otherwise, X number of Elder Horrors appear on the panels around him, where X=number of Servants on the board. (Active) [Anti-Army] Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 3x4 or 4x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Gilles for 5x damage; then has the following effects- 1. Reduce the NP Cooldown of all allied Foreigner-class Servants within a 3 panel area of himself by 1◈ Turns. Also affects non-Foreigner Class Servant Units with the 'Existence outside the Domain' Skill or 'Outsider' Attribute, but NP Cooldown is reduced by ½◈ Turns instead. 2. Inflicts Atk Dwn for 1◈ Turns on the DUs, all damage dealt is reduced by 40%; if NP, 20%. 3. Inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns on the DUs, all damage taken is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.
In one line: His living spellbook: the source of his spells, which can take hits for him.
Lore: what it is: A grimoire bound in human skin that serves as a vast mana reserve, letting Gilles cast great sorcery regardless of his aptitude and summon endless water demons from another world.
Lore: how it looks: A book bound in human skin.
Icon concept: Base: a thick spellbook bound in pale leather, tentacles curling from its pages. Accent: as Caster it floats open in his hand. Reads at 24px as: an open book with curls.

Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Lawful' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 3. Applies Heal Up for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Good' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, when an affected Unit has its Health restored, the amount restored is increased by 80%. 4. If there an allied non-Alter Jeanne d'Arc is present on the field, NP Cooldown is reduced by 2◈ Turns. If there is an allied non-Alter Jeanne d'Arc within a 3 panel area of Gilles, NP Cooldown is reduced by 4◈ Turns instead. If said Unit is standing directly next to Gilles, NP Cooldown is reduced by 6◈ Turns instead. ME Activated 1. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Chaotic' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 3. Applies Heal Up for 1◈ Turns to all Units with the 'Evil' Alignment within a 2 panel area of himself, when an affected Unit has its Health restored, the amount restored is increased by 80%. 4. If there is an allied Jeanne d'Arc Alter present on the field, apply Dmg Boost (Gilles) for 1◈ Turns to himself, all damage dealt by Gilles and his Horrors is increased by 30. If there is an allied Jeanne d'Arc Alter within a 3 panel area of Gilles, 60 instead of 30. If said Unit is standing directly next to Gilles, 90 instead of 30. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Beside his saint: readies his ultimate, or rages if madness took him.
Lore: what it is: The page lists By The Holy Maiden's Side as the Grand Order upgrade of Golden Rule, with no further detail.
Icon concept: A white lily before a fleur-de-lis banner. A flower and a flag. White and gold. Reads at 24px as: a white lily.

What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. (Passive) When this Skill is used, Gilles has a 15% chance of permanently activating his Mad Enhancement Skill. At least two DUs have at least 3 Parameters respectively that are equal to or higher than Gray's. 2. There is only one DU in the NP area. 3. At least two DUs have the 'Evil' Alignment. 4. Gray's Health is less than at least two of the DUs. 5. None of the DUs have at least 3 Parameters respectively that are two Ranks below Gray's. 6. None of the DUs have the 'Elemental' Attribute. If none of the criteria are met, Rhongomyniad deals 3x damage plus 100. For every criteria that is met, damage dealt is increased by 0.2x (e.g. 4 criteria met, damage=3.8x). Note: Criteria 1, 3, 4, and 5 are also accounted for when Criteria 2 is fulfilled, in this case the single DU needs to meet the conditions of the Criteria for them to be fulfilled. When Rhongomyniad is used and none of the criteria are met, Gray's Master loses 30 Health as the cost for this NP. For every criteria that is met, his Master loses an additional 10 Health. Then, all affected enemy Units are inflicted with NP Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns, all NP damage received is increased by 30%; and inflicted with Def Dwn (C) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 20%, and Agility is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. Then, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn for each Criteria that is met and gain 2 Mythos Counters for every Unit hit by this NP. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns if no criteria are met, increases by ½◈ Turns for every criteria that is met. Name: Zabaniya: Delusional Illusion
What it does (system): (Passive) Hassan's Master has a total of 100 Hassans. Hassan is only defeated when all 100 Hassans are defeated. At the start of the game, the Master can start with more than 1 Hassan in its Home Base. At the start of a Round, the Master can deploy additional Hassans onto its half of the field (or within a 2 panel area from the border of its Home Base). There can only be a maximum of ten Hundred-Faced Hassans on the field. Each Hassan is counted as a separate Unit, with its own Stats. Each Hassan will be coded with a number in ascending order when they are deployed. Skill & NP Cooldowns are shared between all Hassans except Presence Concealment & Battle Retreat. If more than one Hassan has a NP Regen buff, only the one with the strongest magnitude takes effect. When counting the number of Units who Move/Attack during your Turn, one Hundred-Faced Hassan counts as 0.5 of a Unit. The same Hassan can only Move/Attack once per Turn. (Active) [Anti-Army] Base Attack (STR) is used. Cannot be used if you have 10 or less Hassans remaining. Hits a 3x3 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Hassan for 3.5x damage plus 200; then inflicts Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is decreased by 25%; and inflicts Def Dwn (A) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received is increased by 20%, and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. Then, reduce the number of Hassans by 4d6. Cooldown: 6◈+⅔◈ Turns.
In one line: A hundred bodies: only falls when all hundred are defeated.
Lore: what it is: He splits his psyche into 100 personalities (80 can manifest at once), each a separate body with its own skills; the sum is weaker than the whole, but Presence Concealment is shared.
Lore: how it looks: Multiple separate bodies manifest, each a different persona.
Icon concept: Dozens of black silhouettes behind one white skull mask. Many shapes behind an oval. Bone white mask, shadow crowd. Reads at 24px as: a mask in a crowd.

In one line: Fearless: resists mind tricks and can boost physical damage.
Lore: what it is: His daring spirit shuts out mental interference like suppression, confusion and charm, and raises melee damage; it stops working under Mad Enhancement.
Icon concept: A lion's face roaring in gold. A rounded mane shape. Ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold mane.

In one line: Battle instinct: dodges, and lands harder critical blows.
Lore: what it is: A danger-avoidance sense born of many ordeals, almost an instinct, that still works despite his madness and sees through feints.
Icon concept: A narrowed eye with a feint line slicing past it. An eye and a slash. Agility teal. Reads at 24px as: a slit eye.

Name: God Hand: Twelve Labors
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Whenever Heracles' Health is reduced to 0, roll ten twenty-sided dice, and restore his Health by the number rolled. If the damage of the Attack that defeated Heracles exceeds his current Health, the excess damage is reduced from his newly restored Health, and so on. Can only be used 11 times. (Passive 2) Whenever an Attack reduces Heracles' Health to 0 for the first time, record that Attack under this Skill. These recorded Attacks can no longer defeat Heracles- whenever a recorded Attack would reduce his Health to 0, his Health will remain at 1 instead.
In one line: Twelve labours: comes back to life again and again.
Lore: what it is: An immortality blessing and curse: his body becomes armour that nullifies attacks of Rank B or lower, and it revives him 11 times, so he must die 12 times.

In one line: Refuses to fall: survives a killing blow and fights on.

Name: The Mist: Darkened Misty Metropolis
What it does (system): (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, a cloud of Mist forms around Jack which covers a maximum of 25 panels. This area can be in any shape, but cannot expand past a distance of 4 panels from Jack (including diagonal). The effects of this Mist are as follows- 1. Normal Humans immediately die if they are caught in the Mist (this counts as Jack killing the Human). 2. Enemy Masters and non-normal Humans are inflicted with Poison upon contact with the Mist; and are inflicted with Poison at the end of its Turn or at the end of a Turn they Act while still within the Mist. (High Rank Masters are not inflicted with Poison upon contact.) 3. Whenever an enemy Servant within the Mist Rolls for Evade, increase the value rolled by 3. 4. The Move of all enemy Units within the Mist is halved. 5. The Detect of all enemy Units within the Mist is reduced to 1 panel. A Servant ignores effects 3, 4 and 5 if they have the Instinct Skill of Rank B or higher. Effect 4 is also ignored by any allied Units of that Servant with Instinct (Rank B or higher) who are standing directly next to them. 6. Jack's Master loses 15 Health at the end of the Turn after every 1◈ Turns since activation. Forcefully deactivated if her Master has 15 Health or less and would lose Health this way, at the end of a Turn Jack is defeated, or at any time Jack chooses. 7. Jack is not affected by the Fog of War area within the Mist. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns after The Mist is deactivated.
In one line: Fills an area with toxic fog that hides her and hurts foes.
Lore: what it is: A Bounded Field Noble Phantasm recreating London's sulfuric-acid smog; Servants take no damage but lose a rank of Agility, and she picks who is affected.
Lore: how it looks: A mist of sulfuric acid, created with magical energy.

Name: Carolus Patricius
What it does (system): (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, place the 'Carolus Patricius' token on the board, with the middle panel being the panel Karl was standing on. The token has an area of 9x9 panels. All Units who were within a 9x9 panel area of Karl are moved onto the 'Patricius' token. Has the following effects- 1. The Carolus functions as a second Home Base for Karl's faction. 2. Karl's Master's ZON is ignored when he Attacks (no damage reduction) while within the Patricius. 3. In order to Escape the Carolus, enemy Servants have to Succeed a Luck Check against Karl (can be performed anywhere within the Carolus). If Successful, the Unit is Moved to the nearest panel immediately outside the Carolus. 4. Enemy Units can attempt to enter the Carolus. Either the Unit's STR or AGI Parameter has to be Rank A, and the nearest panel of the Carolus must be within the Unit's MOV minus 2 (when attempting to enter the Patricius, the Unit's MOV is reduced by 2). 5. All damage received by allied Units within the Patricius is reduced by 15% including NP. 6. Units within the Carolus cannot be targeted by Attacks from outside the Carolus and vice versa. However, the Patricius can be Attacked with an AoE Noble Phantasm. In this case, all Servants within the Carolus receive damage from the NP, but Total Damage received is reduced by 50%; while Masters are undamaged and unaffected by other effects. Note: If the NP used on the Carolus was an [Anti-Fortress] or higher Noble Phantasm, Carolus Patricius is forcefully ended at the end of the Combat Process. 7. All damage dealt by allied Units within the Carolus is increased by 15% except Noble Phantasms. 8. Units can Move under the Carolus (i.e. onto panels occupied by the Patricius, place the Carolus token on top of those Units). 9. Carolus Patricius initially lasts for 2◈ Turns. After the initial NP period, Karl can extend the duration of Carolus Patricius by 1◈ more Turns by reducing his Health by 200 (cannot be used if Karl's Health is less than 200), and can be repeatedly extended. 10. The Carolus is forcefully ended at the end of the Turn if Karl or his Master is defeated. Cannot be used if Carolus Patricius Auctoritas is on Cooldown. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns after the NP ends.
In one line: Raises a giant fortress over the field to shelter his allies.

All damage taken is reduced by 10% including NP. 3. Max Health is increased by 100. 4. Max Agility is increased by 1. 5. Max Luck is increased by 1. 6. At the end of every Turn an allied Unit Acts, its Health is restored by 5% of its maximum value. The magnitudes of Effects 1, 2, and 6 are doubled when the affected Unit is in its Home Base. (Ceremonial Reformation)

All damage received from Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute or Units with the 'Divine' Attribute but without the 'Christian' Attribute is reduced by 25% including NP. (Active) Used during your Turn. Name: Innocent World

STR highest: All damage dealt is reduced by 50%; if NP, 25%. 2. END highest: All damage received is increased by 50%; if NP, 25%. 3. AGI highest: The value of Evade rolls are increased by 4. 4. MAG highest: Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is increased by 50% and Total Debuff Damage taken is increased by 50%. 5. LUC highest: The value of Luck Check rolls are increased by 4. 6. If the Unit has any NP whose Rank is higher than all its Parameters: The Servant is affected with NP Seal. Icon concept: Four spectral figures in a ring, holding hands around a blindfolded shape. A ring of four. Pale and black. Reads at 24px as: a ring of four figures.

Icon concept: A bronze Greek helm cracked by a fist. A crested helm with a crack. Bronze and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a cracked helm.

Icon concept: A roaring mouth with sound rings and Amazon spears behind. Arcs and spears. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: arcs and spears.

Lore: what it is: She excites her vengeance against Achilles and Ares' blood, turning herself into a true mad warrior that has thrown away reason.

Name: Bab-ilu: Key of the King's Law To Enshrine
What it does (system): Rank: E~A++ (Passive) Whenever Proto Gil Attacks an enemy Unit at a Range of 2 or higher, he can Move to any panel that is directly next to the DU and perform an additional Normal Attack on that DU; if the DU Blocked the first Attack, it also has to Block the second Attack, while if the DU successfully Evaded the first Attack, it has a choice to Block or Evade the second Attack. (Active) Base Attack (STR) is used. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 3x damage. Then, all affected DUs roll 3 twenty-sided dice and are inflicted with the corresponding debuffs for 1◈ Turns- 1. Atk Dwn 30%; if NP, 15% 2. Def Dwn 30% 3. Crit Dwn 30% 4. Crit DmDwn 30% 5. NP DmDwn 30% 6. Debuff ResDwn 30% 7. Debuff ChDwn 30% 8. Buff ChDwn 30% 9. No Buff (1 time per number of dice which rolled a 9) 10. NP Seal 11. Skill Seal 12. AGL Dwn (+3) 13. LUC Dwn (+3) 14. MOV Dwn (-3) 15. TEC Dwn (-3) 16. Bal Dwn 30% 17. Heal Dwn 30% 18. NP Degen 19. Terror 30% 20. Decoy. If the same number is rolled, that debuff is applied the same amount of times its number is rolled; for debuffs which do not stack, its duration is extended instead. Gilgamesh's Master loses Health equivalent to if an E Rank NP is used. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.

Water damage. Then, the area affected by this NP becomes a 'Waterside' area for 7◈ Turns. In one line: The sword of the end: a growing flood that drowns everything at last.

Lore: how it looks: A sword that calls up a growing flood and a tsunami.

Name: Enkidu: Chains of Heaven
What it does (system): Rank: ??? Range=3. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals normal damage and has a 50% chance of inflicting Stun for 1◈ Turns. Damage dealt and chance of inflicting Stun increases the higher the Divinity Rank of the DU. Rank EX: Damage dealt increased by 150%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 100%. Rank A: Damage dealt increased by 100%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 50%. Rank B: Damage dealt increased by 80%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 40%. Rank C: Damage dealt increased by 60%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 30%. Rank D: Damage dealt increased by 40%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 20%. Rank E: Damage dealt increased by 20%, chance of inflicting Stun increased by 10%. If the DU has the 'Divine' Attribute but no 'Divinity' Skill, treat it as if it has Rank A Divinity. Additionally, if the DU has the 'Divine' Attribute, Debuff Immune effects cannot prevent Stun from being inflicted, even those which specifically affect Stun (Debuff Resist can still reduce the chance). Does not decrease Master's Health when used. Cooldown: 5◈ Turns

In one line: Wrestling flair: huge crit chance and crit damage for a moment.

In one line: Raises the Sun Stone over the field, empowering her while it hangs.

Name: Quetzalcoatl: Winged Serpent
What it does (system): (Non-damaging) When this NP is used, Quetz summons a Quetzalcoatlus at her position, and she is Moved onto the Quetzalcoatlus together with her Master (if her Master is next to the Quetzalcoatlus; otherwise her Master can get on the Quetzalcoatlus at any time). While Quetz is Riding the Quetzalcoatlus, Quetz's Move and Normal Attack is replaced with Quetzalcoatlus'. Quetz or her Master cannot be targeted for an Attack while they are Riding the Quetzalcoatlus. If they are hit with an AoE Attack, the Quetzalcoatlus receives full damage, Quetz receives 50% Total Damage while her Master receives no damage and effects. The Quetzalcoatlus ignores obstacles while Moving, and can Move onto occupied panels (place the Quetzalcoatlus on top of anything occupying said panels). While Quetz is Riding the Quetzalcoatlus, she is able to use the three Spells listed below. After every 1◈ Turns, Quetz's Master's Health is reduced by 25 at the end of the Turn if this NP is Active unless the NP was deactivated during this Round. If her Master's Health is 25 or less, this NP is forcefully deactivated at the end of the Round. This NP can be deactivated during Quetz's Turn or at the start or end of any Round or Turn, but cannot be deactivated for 2◈ Turns after it was activated. Cooldown: 7◈ Turns after Quetzalcoatlus is defeated.
In one line: Summons a giant winged reptile and flies on it with her Master.
Lore: what it is: Summons a Quetzalcoatlus, a giant Cretaceous pterosaur raised to Phantasmal or Divine Beast level; at True Name release the rider can command large-scale lightning, wind and rain.

Icon concept: A colossal feathered pterosaur in flight, wings spread wide. A wide wing span. Turquoise and gold. Reads at 24px as: spread wings.

Name: Xiuhcoatl: O Flame, Burn the Gods Themselves
What it does (system): Range+2. Base Attack (STR) and half of Base Attack (MAG) is used (BA=250), not affected by Magic Resistance. Deals 4x damage and inflicts NP Seal for 1◈ Turns, and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage (half). Then (regardless of whether the NP hits the DU or not), deals normal damage to all Units within a 2 panel area of the targeted Unit except Quetzalcoatl and the targeted Unit (Base Attack (MAG) is used) with a 25% chance of inflicting NP Seal for 1◈ Turns and inflicts Burn for 1◈ Turns. Fire damage. Xiuhcoatl cannot be used if Quetz is Riding the Quetzalcoatlus. If this NP is used on a Unit within or directly next to a [Fortress] NP (regardless of ally's or enemy's), that NP area and the panels directly outside/next to the NP area are now 'Burning' until the Fortress NP is deactivated. In one line: A flaming meteor dive that seals the target's ultimate and burns them.

Icon concept: A fiery serpent-shaped meteor diving from the sky. A flaming streak with a head. Ember and turquoise. Reads at 24px as: a fiery streak.

Name: Goō Shōriki・Dohatsu Tenshou
What it does (system): Ox King's Power: Rising Fury. Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is Active. Range=3. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range. First, deal 0.5x damage four times using Base Attack (STR), each instance of damage respectively being Lightning damage (half), Fire damage (half), Ice damage (half) and Wind damage (half). Each of these four Attacks can be separately Blocked or Evaded; treat these Attacks as Normal Attacks. These 4 Attacks are not affected by Mad Enhancement. Then, deals 3.5x damage plus 200 using Base Attack (MAG) and inflicts Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Treat this part as the Noble Phantasm. Then, inflict Crit Dwn on all affected Units for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 20%. Cooldown: 6◈+⅔◈ Turns. If used while Goō Shōrai・Tenmōkaikai is Active, it is immediately ended at the end of that Combat Phase, and its Cooldown is increased by 2◈ Turns.
In one line: In fury, calls her four retainers' lightning weapons down on an area.
Lore: what it is: Goo Shorai - Tenmokaikai (mode of): Raikou summons the divine ox messenger of Gozu Tenno, the source of her demonic nature, and sweeps the enemy camp. In FGO it hits all enemies, and at B++ boosts star generation on overcharge.
Lore: how it looks: Weapons manifest by lightning, modeled on the souls of her four retainers.
Icon concept: Four lightning-forged weapons crashing down together. Four bolts converging. Yellow-violet lightning. Reads at 24px as: four converging bolts.

What it does (system): (Passive) The magnitude of all Atk Dwn effects on Raikou is halved.
