In one line: Genji training: weakening barely works on her, and she crits more.
Lore: what it is: Her Genji arms mastery at EX rank, the Fate/Grand Order upgrade of Eternal Arms Mastery; the page gives no further description.
Icon concept: A katana in a Genji gentian crest. A blade in a crest. Steel and violet. Reads at 24px as: a blade in a crest.

Name: Mana Burst (Lightning)
What it does (system): (Passive) Raikou is Immune to Shock. All Lightning damage taken is reduced by 50% including NP. (Active) Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is not Active. This Skill is used when Raikou performs a Normal Attack. For that Combat Process, the Base Attack used is her BA(STR) and BA(MAG) combined (BA=350), and the Attack inflicts Shock for 2◈ Turns. Not affected by Magic Resistance. Lightning damage (half). Then, applies Dodge to herself for ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: Lightning in her strikes: immune to shock, and lightning barely hurts her.
Lore: what it is: Because Gozu Tennou is the incarnation of Taishakuten (Indra), Raikou holds Kitano Tenjin's thunder power, expressed as a Mana Burst skill.
Icon concept: Base: an impact burst erupting from a strike. Accent: it crackles with violet lightning. Reads at 24px as: a violet burst.

Name: Mystery Slayer
What it does (system): (Passive 1) All damage dealt to Units with the '[Earth]' or '[Sky]' Attribute is increased by 20% including NP. (Passive 2) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute is increased by 20% including NP. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up (MS) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the '[Earth]' or '[Sky]' Attribute is increased by 30% including NP; and applies Atk Up (Demonic) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute is increased by 30% including NP. Note: Mystery Slayer and Atk Up (MS) have no effect on 'Demi-Servants' and 'Pseudo-Servants' except Sitonai. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Slayer of the uncanny: hits monsters and demons much harder.
Lore: what it is: Her fame as the Heian era's strongest slayer of mysteries became a skill that is especially effective as Anti-Mystery.
Icon concept: A demon's horned mask split by a sword stroke. A mask cut by a line. Crimson and steel. Reads at 24px as: a split mask.

Name: Goō Shōrai・Tenmōkaikai
What it does (system): (Non-damaging/Passive) Ox-King Storm Call: The Inescapable Net of Heaven. Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is deactivated (Mad Enhancement can be reactivated after this NP is activated). Raikou summons four extra clones of herself on the panels in front of her, behind her, and her left and right. The clones have the same Max Agility, Max Luck and MOV as Raikou, but half her Max Health; they cannot use Mad Enhancement, Riding or the Active effects of Raikou's Skills (Passive effects are still present), and can only perform Normal Attacks. During the NP duration, Raikou's Attacks deal 50% extra damage and inflict Shock for 2◈ Turns, Lightning damage (half). Raikou's Crit Chance is increased by 30%, the copies' by 15%. At the end of Raikou's Turn and at the end of any Turn Raikou or any of her copies Acts, Raikou's Master loses 25 Health. This NP is forcefully deactivated if Raikou's Master has 25 Health or less and would lose Health due to this effect; her Master does not lose Health on the same Turn this NP is deactivated. It is also forcefully deactivated at the end of a Turn Raikou is defeated. Raikou's copies do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn, and the same copy can only Move/Attack once per Turn. Enemy Units cannot Attack Raikou or her Master if any Raikou copies are next to them. Cooldown: 7◈+⅓◈ Turns after this NP is deactivated or after the last Raikou copy is defeated.
In one line: The net of heaven: no foe on the field escapes her storm.
Lore: what it is: Her Noble Phantasm, Ox-King Storm Call - The Inescapable Net of Heaven, which overpowered Suzuka Gozen's Noble Phantasm in Fate/EXTRA CCC Fox Tail.
Icon concept: A net of lightning stretched across a storm sky. A web of zigzags. Violet lightning on night. Reads at 24px as: a lightning web.

Name: Thunder God's Embodiment
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Can only be used when Mad Enhancement is Active. 1. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 40%; if NP, 30%. 2. Applies Dodge for ⅓◈ Turns. 3. Applies the Raikou buff for 3 times: Normal Attacks deal 40 bonus Lightning damage with a 40% chance of inflicting Shock for ⅔◈ Turns, and reduce her NP Cooldown by ⅓◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Becomes the thunder god: hits much harder and dodges.
Lore: what it is: Thunder God Manifestation, the FGO upgrade of her Mana Burst (Lightning) skill.
Icon concept: A drum ring of thunder around a woman's silhouette. A ring of drums. Violet and gold. Reads at 24px as: a ring around a figure.

Name: Brahmastra: Rakshasa-Piercing Immortal

Without 'Demonic' Attribute: Total Damage dealt is reduced by 20%. Then, has the following effects- 1. Inflicts Def Dwn (B) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is increased by 20%; if NP, 30%. 2. If the DU has the 'Demonic' Attribute, its NP Cooldown is increased by 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns
In one line: A burning arrow-sword that devastates demons above all.
Lore: what it is: Originally an arrow, but Rama, who wanted to be a Saber, forcibly remodelled it into a sword that can still be thrown violently.
Lore: how it looks: A sword that was originally an arrow.
Icon concept: A sword shaped like an arrow, blazing as it is thrown. A blade with flame. Ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a flaming blade.

Name: Curse of Separation
What it does (system): (Passive) When Rama would be defeated and is not revived by any effect, for every Reunion Counter on himself, he has a 3% chance of having that Attack be canceled, then Sita is summoned on a panel directly next to himself (will be contracted to Rama's Master). Can only activate once per game.
In one line: If he falls for good, Sita may appear in his place.
Lore: what it is: A curse laid by Vali's wife, so Rama can never meet Sita, his other half; when summoned, Sita appears as a separate aspect of Rama.
Icon concept: Two hands reaching for each other, a crack between them. Two hands and a gap. Gold and crimson. Reads at 24px as: two hands apart.

Name: Dream of Reunion
What it does (system): (Passive) Whenever Rama is defeated and revived with an effect, gain 1 Reunion Counter. (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts for 1◈ Turns, when Rama is defeated, he is revived with 100 Health. 2. Restores Rama's Health by 25% of its maximum value. 3. NP Cooldown is reduced by 1◈ Turns. 4. Applies S.Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 5. Gain 1 Reunion Counter. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Each time he returns from death, his hope of reunion grows.
Lore: what it is: The FGO upgrade of Curse of Separation; the page gives no further description.
Icon concept: A crescent moon over two silhouettes walking toward each other. Two figures under a moon. Gold and blue. Reads at 24px as: two figures under a moon.

Name: Martial Blessing

In one line: Vishnu's martial blessing: unlocks his weapons and sharpens crits.
Lore: what it is: Rama, fated to defeat Ravana, excels in all martial arts; it lets him wield his spear and bow at near-Noble Phantasm power as a Saber.

Lore: what it is: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: the clubs (gada) Modhaki and Shikhari.

Fire damage (half). Cooldown: 7◈ Turns. This NP is treated as a Rank A NP.

In one line: A lightning trident sweep that may shock everyone in front.
Lore: what it is: One of the weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons, available through Vishnu Bhuja: Shiva's trident Trishula.

What it does (system): When Rama is summoned, Flip a Coin. If Heads, roll 2 six-sided die; if Tails, roll 1 six-sided die. Note: If a 6 is rolled, the player can choose any of the available Noble Phantasms (that hasn't been chosen yet). A double other than 6 rolls its second die again.
In one line: Vishnu's arms: a random set of divine weapons each battle.
Lore: what it is: Rama's second Noble Phantasm, giving him the many weapons Vishwamitra granted against gods and demons; higher Divinity raises how many he can bring out.
Lore: how it looks: A set of weapons including chakrams, a javelin, clubs, a trident and a bow.
Icon concept: A wheel of divine weapons arranged like a clock: chakram, club, trident, bow, javelin. A ring of weapons. Gold and blue. Reads at 24px as: a weapon wheel.

In one line: A sun rune: an ally regains footing and hits much harder.
Lore: what it is: A rune of Scathach's Primordial Runes (mode of Primeval Rune). In FGO, Primeval Rune raises one ally's Quick performance and buff success rate and charges their NP gauge.
Icon concept: A primordial rune shaped like a rising sun, glowing ember. A semicircle glyph. Ember on grey. Reads at 24px as: a sun rune.

Name: Gáe Bolg Alternative: Soaring Spear of Piercing Death
What it does (system): Base Attack (STR) is used. Range 4. Has a 500% chance of inflicting Stun for 1◈ Turns; then has a 75% chance of inflicting Instakill. If Instakill is not inflicted, this NP deals 3.5x damage plus 100. Cooldown 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Twin spears: stuns, then likely kills; if not, a brutal hit.
Lore: what it is: Scathach holds two spears older than Cu Chulainn's Gae Bolg: one pins a foe in place at close range, and a thrown second one pierces everything in its line.
Lore: how it looks: Demonic spears, one used close and one thrown.
Icon concept: Two crimson spears, one thrust and one thrown, crossing. A red X. Crimson. Reads at 24px as: a red X.

Name: Gate of Skye: Gate to the Magical Realm Brimming with Death
What it does (system): Affects all of Scáthach's targets of choice within a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to her. All targeted Units perform a Luck Check; if their MAG is Rank B, the value rolled is reduced by 2, and if their MAG is Rank A, by 4. If the targeted Unit's Luck Check fails, it is inflicted with Death. If it succeeds, it receives 4x damage plus 100, using Scáthach's Base Attack (MAG). Masters can be targeted regardless of their distance from their Servant. Cooldown 7◈+⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Primordial Rune, Wisdom of Dún Scáith and/or Gáe Bolg Alternative are on Cooldown; when this NP is used, Primordial Rune and Wisdom of Dún Scáith enter Cooldown.
In one line: Opens the gate to the land of shadows: the unlucky are swallowed.
Lore: what it is: Her main Noble Phantasm summons a massive gate to the Land of Shadows that draws in life; targets who fail resistance die, and she can choose who may enter.
Lore: how it looks: A massive gate to the Land of Shadows.
Icon concept: A towering dark gate opening onto a void of shadow. An arch with darkness. Black and violet. Reads at 24px as: a dark arch.

Applies Dmg Up (Gods) for 1◈ Turns — damage dealt to Units with the 'Undead' or 'Divine' Attribute is further increased by 70% — and applies the 'Alpi' buff for 1◈ Turns, 3 times. Cooldown 4◈ Turns.
In one line: A slayer of gods: much more damage to the divine and the undead.
Lore: what it is: Her long slaying of divine spirits as gatekeeper of the Shadow Realm became a skill strongly effective against Divine Spirits, wraiths and Servants with Divinity.
Icon concept: A spear through a broken halo. A line through a broken ring. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a spear through a ring.

What it does (system): (Passive 1) If Scáthach uses a Primordial Rune Spell while she has any PRS Tokens, remove one PRS Token from herself, and the Primordial Rune Spell she used does not enter Cooldown. In one line: A rune master: some rune spells cost no cooldown.
Lore: what it is: She knows the Primal Runes of the Age of Gods spread by Odin, different from modern runes; she gave Cu Chulainn 18 of them.
Lore: how it looks: Rune effects shown as fire tornadoes, ice spikes, a rune map and a rune barrier.
Icon concept: A circle of primordial runes carved into stone, one lit. A ring of glyphs. Mana blue on grey. Reads at 24px as: a ring of glyphs.

In one line: Casts random primordial runes on an ally or foe.

What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has an 80% chance of applying Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns (Crit Damage +50%), an 80% chance of applying Crit Up for 1◈ Turns (Crit Chance +50%), and applies Dodge for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown 4◈-⅓◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Wisdom of Dún Scáith (Skill 1) or (Skill 2) is on Cooldown.

Name: Wisdom of Dún Scáith
What it does (system): When Scáthach is Summoned, she is given a list of Skills (preferably Rank B to Rank A) that must have an Active effect, of all other Servants on the field, excluding Class Skills. Lore: what it is: She uses doves as familiars, directed by thought without a contract.
Icon concept: A white dove with an eye on its wing. A bird shape. White and violet. Reads at 24px as: a white dove.

Name: Hanging Gardens of Babylon: Aerial Garden of Vanity
What it does (system): (Activation) Only in effect and usable if Semiramis was summoned with the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. Hanging Gardens of Babylon (HGoB) can only be used when the HGoB Construction counter reaches 100. In order to activate the Hanging Gardens of Babylon, Semiramis has to be within her Home Base, and cannot Act for 3◈ Turns. If Semiramis is Attacked during this period, the period of 3◈ Turns is interrupted and she has to restart the activation process. If Semiramis is not interrupted, the Hanging Gardens of Babylon is activated at the end of the last Turn in that period. Semiramis' Master only loses Health as per NP usage rules only when HGoB successfully activates, not at the start of the NP activation process. However, Semiramis can perform the activation without being in her Master's ZON.
In one line: Raises her flying palace above the battlefield.
Lore: what it is: A flying fortress in which all her parameters rise a rank, her fame peaks and other Servants' fame drops to zero; eleven black plates orbit it as cannons.
Lore: how it looks: An enormous fortress hanging in the air, orbited by eleven pure black plates over 20 meters long.
Icon concept: An inverted palace floating in the sky, ringed by eleven black plates. An inverted wedge with dark orbs. Bone, verdant and black. Reads at 24px as: an inverted palace.

Name: Aerial Garden of Vanity
What it does (system): Range=7. Cannot hit under or above the HGoB. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 7x7 panel area within Range for 2x damage. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.
In one line: The flying palace bombards a wide square of ground below it.
Lore: what it is: The Hanging Gardens of Babylon (Aerial Garden of Vanity) is a giant floating fortress, Nebuchadnezzar II's Noble Phantasm, usable by Semiramis and her strongest, largest one.
Lore: how it looks: Floating masses covered in marble floors, balconies, pillars and tangled plant life, like an upside-down palace.
Icon concept: The Hanging Gardens seen from below: an upside-down palace of marble, vines trailing, firing beams straight down. An inverted wedge with vertical lines under it. Bone white stone, verdant vines, Mana-blue beams. Reads at 24px as: an inverted triangle raining lines.

Name: Dragon Wing Warriors
What it does (system): Range=4 plus the area under the HGoB and the area of the HGoB. Hits a 5x5 panel area within Range. All affected Units receive 50 Fixed STR damage X times, where X=Number rolled on a six-sided die plus 4. Each instance of damage can be separately Evaded or Blocked. Damaged Units only perform an Injury Roll once regardless of number of hits taken. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns.
In one line: Harpy-winged soldiers dive in waves, striking everything in an area again and again.
Lore: what it is: Semiramis' special modified flying soldiers, defending the Hanging Gardens of Babylon.
Lore: how it looks: Upper halves of regular soldiers with the lower halves of Harpies.
Icon concept: Three harpy-winged soldiers diving in a staggered line, wings swept back like arrowheads. Three stacked chevrons. Bone ink bodies, ember-gold wingtips on night. Reads at 24px as: three falling chevrons.

Name: Item Construction
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Roll a four-sided die; Semiramis creates that number of [Semiramis' Poison] Items.
In one line: Brews a few vials of her poison.
Lore: what it is: Lets her create items that carry magical energy, but she specializes in poisons and can make nothing else.
Icon concept: A round alchemist's flask with a glowing liquid and a small gear stamped on the glass. A round-bottomed flask. Verdant liquid in smoked glass on violet night. Reads at 24px as: a round green flask.

Name: [Semiramis' Poison]
What it does (system): Whenever Semiramis is standing directly next to an allied Unit, any number of [Semiramis' Poison] can be passed from Semiramis to that Unit (once per Turn). Consuming 1 grants the 'Queen's Poison' effect for 3◈ Turns.
In one line: A vial of the queen's poison that she can hand to an ally to drink.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A slim cut-glass vial with a dove-shaped stopper, filled with dark violet liquid. A narrow upright bottle. Violet glow inside smoked glass, gold stopper. Reads at 24px as: a small violet bottle.

Name: Scales of the Sacred Fish
What it does (system): Spell. Used at the start of a Combat Phase when Semiramis or an allied Unit within a 2 panel area of herself is Attacked; the Unit gains the Shield (200) buff for 2◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: Raises a shield of fish scales over herself or an ally.
Lore: what it is: She can form the scales of the Sacred Fish on her hand as a defence; in the anime she makes a scale shield to protect others.
Lore: how it looks: Scales formed on her hand, or a shield of scales.
Icon concept: A shield of overlapping iridescent fish scales. A curved scaled plate. Pearl and guard blue. Reads at 24px as: a scaled shield.

Name: Sikera Ušum: Arrogant King's Alcohol
What it does (system): Has different effects depending on whether Semiramis was summoned with the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. 1. If Semiramis was not summoned with it: When this NP is used, it affects the 5x5 panel area around her (which Moves with her) for 2◈ Turns. 2. If Semiramis was summoned with it: Can only be used within the 'Throne Room' of 'Hanging Gardens of Babylon'. Affects the Throne Room for 3◈ Turns, and all Units within the Throne Room when the NP was activated cannot leave it while it is Active. The effects of this NP area are as follows- a. Semiramis' Normal Attacks which use Base Attack (STR) inflict Poison. b. When a Unit other than Semiramis or her Master Acts then ends its Turn within the NP area, it is inflicted with Poison. c. Units inflicted with Poison while within this NP area receive Poison damage at the end of its Turn and at the end of any Turn it Acts, in addition to at the end of the Round. d. When a Unit with Poison Immune effects is in this NP area, the Poison Immune effect is reduced to a Poison Resist effect, the chance of being inflicted with Poison is reduced by 75%. Units with Poison Resist effects that are not Poison Immune in this area have the magnitude of those Poison Resist effects halved. Only applies to effects that specify Poison. e. Units in the NP area who are weak to Poison receive double Poison Damage (in addition to any other effects they might have which increase Poison Damage received). Does not apply to external debuffs or effects affecting said Units. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns after the NP ends.
In one line: Her poison spreads as chains, poisoning everything in an area.
Lore: what it is: Invoked only at her fortress's throne, it grants her magecraft a poison attribute; poison-resistant legends resist it better and poison victims take double.
Lore: how it looks: Poison appears in the form of chains.
Icon concept: Chains of violet poison coiling out from a goblet. A cup with chains. Violet and gold. Reads at 24px as: a cup with chains.

Name: Summoning: Bašmu
What it does (system): Spell. Can only be used when Semiramis has the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. Has different effects depending on whether Semiramis is within her 'Hanging Gardens of Babylon' or not. 1. If used when she is not within her HGoB: Damage Spell. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 25% extra damage and inflicts Poison. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. 2. If used when within her HGoB: Semiramis summons a Bašmu on a panel directly next to her. Counts as her Attack for the Turn. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Summons the horned poison serpent.
Lore: what it is: Inside her Hanging Gardens she can summon Phantasmal creatures tied to poison anecdotes, such as the Basmu; the wiki describes this under Sikera Usum.
Lore: how it looks: A Phantasmal Species poison creature such as the Basmu.
Icon concept: A horned serpent rearing from a magic circle. A coiled shape in a ring. Violet and green. Reads at 24px as: a serpent in a ring.

Name: Territory Creation
What it does (system): Has different effects depending on whether Semiramis has the 'Double Summon: Caster' Skill. 1. If Semiramis has it, the effects of Territory Creation are reduced to Rank C for her Faction's Home Base. Territory Creation Rank EX is only applied to the whole area of Semiramis' 'Hanging Gardens of Babylon'. (Passive 1) When this Unit is in its Home Base, all damage dealt by it is increased by 6d20, including NP. (Passive 2) While this Unit is on the field, all damage taken by allied Units who are in their Home Base is further reduced by (3d10+30), including NP. 2. If Semiramis does not have it, when she uses the 'Double Summon' Skill, she gains the effects of Territory Creation Rank C while she has the 'DSC' buff. Note: If there are multiple allied Units with this Skill, only the Territory Creation with the highest Rank takes effect.
In one line: Strong at home: hits harder in her base, and allies there take less.
Lore: what it is: Creates ground advantageous to a magus; with enough materials she can build a Hanging Garden, which is superior to a temple.
Icon concept: A magic circle glowing on a stone floor, with low walls of light rising at its rim. A flattened ellipse with a rising rim. Crimson-violet circle on deep violet night. Reads at 24px as: a glowing ring on the ground.

Name: Danse Macabre
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. 1. Applies Debuff ChUp for 1◈ Turns; chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by 40%. 2. Applies Death ChUp for 1◈ Turns; chance of inflicting Instakill and Death is increased by 40%. 3. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns; all damage dealt is increased by 30%, if NP 20%. 4. Applies the 'Macabre' buff for 1◈ Turns; Serenity's Normal Attack Crits inflict an additional Stage of Poison on the Defending Unit. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: A death dance: her poisons and killing blows land far more often.
Lore: what it is: Dance of Pale Death (A), the Grand Order upgrade of Dance of Silence: her dance scatters poison that weakens targets and raises her Noble Phantasm's success.
Lore: how it looks: Poison is scattered through her dance.
Icon concept: A dancer's veil swirling, violet mist trailing from it. A swirling ribbon. Violet. Reads at 24px as: a violet swirl.

Name: Projectile (Poisoned Daggers)
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Crit Chance is increased by 15%. (Passive 2) Normal Attacks inflict Poison on the Defending Unit. (Passive 3) Normal Attacks have a 25% chance of inflicting Deadly Poison for 1◈ Turns; Poison Damage received is doubled.
In one line: Poisoned daggers: every hit poisons, and some poison deeply.
Lore: what it is: Poisoned Blade (C++) lets her fight with dirks at range and melee, adding a Poison status; her daggers are white and kunai-shaped.
Lore: how it looks: Her personal dirks are white kunai-shaped daggers.
Icon concept: Three white kunai-shaped daggers in flight, violet drops on their tips. Three narrow shapes. White and violet. Reads at 24px as: three daggers.

Name: Shapeshift (Infiltration Specialization)
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Increase its NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns and inflicts Crit Down for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is reduced by 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Can be used when Presence Concealment is Active, and has a 20% chance of deactivating Presence Concealment when used.
In one line: Infiltrates a foe: delays their ultimate and dulls their crits.
Lore: what it is: Infiltration-specialised shapeshifting: she can change her appearance to a person of similar build, even the opposite sex, to approach her target.
Icon concept: A mask peeling to reveal another face. A face with a lifted edge. Bone and violet. Reads at 24px as: a peeling mask.

Name: Silent Dance
What it does (system): (Passive) Chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by 10%. Chance of inflicting Instakill and Death is increased by 10%.
In one line: Silent grace: her poisons and lethal effects land a bit more often.
Lore: what it is: Dance of Silence (B): a charm-type dance that scatters poison to weaken the target and improve her Noble Phantasm's application.
Icon concept: A bare foot on tiptoe, no sound rings. A foot shape. Bone and violet. Reads at 24px as: a tiptoe foot.

Name: Zabaniya: Delusional Poison Body
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Serenity is Immune to Poison and Deadly Poison. (Passive 2) Any Unit within a 2 panel area of Serenity is inflicted with Poison at the end of her Turn. While Presence Concealment is Active they are inflicted with Secret Poison instead, where the debuff and the total Poison Damage taken is only revealed after Presence Concealment is deactivated. (Active) Range=1. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Deals 3x damage plus 100, not affected by Magic Resistance. After dealing damage: inflicts Stage 3 Poison on the Defending Unit; inflicts Deadly Poison for 2◈ Turns, Poison Damage received is doubled; 40% chance to inflict Skill Seal for 1◈ Turns; 40% chance to inflict NP Seal for 1◈ Turns; 60% chance to inflict Instakill. Cooldown: 5◈+⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Her body is poison: anyone near her is poisoned every turn.
Lore: what it is: Her whole body is poison: nails, skin, fluids and even her sweet scent are lethal, and any contact is fatal, typically by a poisonous kiss.
Icon concept: A woman's outline exhaling a sweet violet haze, a blooming flower in it. A figure in a haze. Violet and rose. Reads at 24px as: a violet haze.

Name: Akafiloga Argrise: Incandescent Dragon's Breath・Earth Liquefaction
What it does (system): Usage 1. Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 5x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Sieg. First inflicts Def Dwn for 1◈ Turns on all affected Units, all damage taken is increased by 30%; then deals 5x damage. Fire damage. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns. As Fafnir: its Def Dwn is 50%; the transformation ends at the end of the Turn it was used, and Sieg's Master loses Health as per when a Servant uses its NP, doubled. Note: cannot be used while Usage 2 is on Cooldown.
In one line: Breathes the dragon's fire over an area, melting its armour.
Lore: what it is: A Noble Phantasm that transforms him temporarily into the dragon Fafnir and unleashes a massive dragon's breath, drawn from his legend of turning into a dragon and flying.
Lore: how it looks: Fafnir's dragon form; the transformation destroys his body, leaving only his soul.
Icon concept: A dragon's open jaw pouring incandescent fire onto liquefying ground. A jaw and a flood. Ember and black. Reads at 24px as: fire from a jaw.

Name: Akafiloga Argrise: Fafnir
What it does (system): Usage 2 (Activation/Non-damaging). Sieg transforms into Fafnir. As Fafnir: a. Max & current Health is increased by 300% (quadrupled). b. Base Attack (STR) is increased by 150, Base Attack (MAG) is increased by 125. c. All damage taken is reduced by 75%; if NP, 50%. No Injury Rolls when damaged by an Attack unless by an NP. d. Cannot Block; when he performs an Agility Check, double the value of the roll. e. Can Move to any panel; Units on panels he Moves into are knocked back by 1 panel until he can stand there. f. Gains the 'Large' Attribute. He is 3x3. g. At the end of every Turn this NP is Active, Sieg's Master loses 40 Health if Fafnir Acted, 20 if he did not (instead of the usual NP cost). If the Master's Health is not above that, the NP ends at that Turn's end and the Master loses nothing. h. Cannot use any Skill or NP but Usage 1. j. Sieg can end it during his Turn, or at the start or end of any Turn or Round. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns after it ends. Cannot be used while Usage 1 is on Cooldown.
In one line: Transforms into the dragon Fafnir, vastly stronger and tougher.
Lore: what it is: The same Noble Phantasm's transformation: Sieg's dragon-blooded heart from Siegfried transfigures him into Fafnir.
Lore: how it looks: Forced transformation into the dragon Fafnir.
Icon concept: The silhouette of the great dragon Fafnir, wings spread. A dragon shape. Black and ember. Reads at 24px as: a dragon silhouette.

Name: Blasted Tree: The Lightning Tree of Crucifixion
What it does (system): Base Attack (MAG) is used. Range=1. Deals 2.5x damage to the DU, then all Units within a 3x3 panel area of the DU other than Sieg receive 1.5x damage (these DUs can Evade/Block, but cannot Counter). Has a 25% chance of inflicting Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: A lightning strike on one foe that splashes on all around them.
Lore: what it is: A suicidal Noble Phantasm of Frankenstein whose life and will passed to Sieg; he uses a much weaker version in the final battle as a trump card.
Icon concept: A split tree struck by lightning, sparks flying. A cracked trunk and a bolt. Yellow shock and black. Reads at 24px as: a struck tree.

Name: Bridal Chest: A Maiden's Chastity
What it does (system): (Passive 1) At a Range of 1, Sieg's Normal Attacks use his Base Attack (STR). At a Range of 2 or higher, Sieg's Normal Attacks use his Base Attack (MAG) and deal Lightning damage with a 10% chance of inflicting Shock for 1◈ Turns. If Sieg is affected with NP Seal, his Range is reduced to 1 for the duration of NP Seal. (Passive 2) After every 3 full Rounds, increase Sieg's Max and current Agility by 1 (maximum increase = 4), and Base Attack (both) by 10 (no limit) at the end of the Round. (Passive 3) Sieg gains the 'Galvanism' Skill.
In one line: A homunculus's weapon: close blows are physical, distant ones lightning.
Lore: what it is: Reborn inside him as a piece of Frankenstein, it grants a 'perpetual motion machine' ability to transform and fire Balmung repeatedly.
Icon concept: A slender bladed halberd crackling with lightning. A pole weapon with sparks. Steel and yellow. Reads at 24px as: a sparking halberd.

Name: Dead Count Shapeshifter: Siegfried
What it does (system): (Active) Usage 2. Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase. Requires 1 DRCS to use. When this Skill is used, reduce Sieg's DRCS by 1, then Sieg is transformed into Siegfried, with all Skills and NP available and usable (although NP can only be used if the number of Rounds passed meets the game conditions). Roll a four-sided die. Sieg's transformation into Siegfried lasts for X Turns, where X=(1◈+[½◈*Number rolled on the four-sided die]). When Sieg transforms into 'Siegfried', he keeps all buffs, debuffs, and other effects that were affecting him before he transformed. When the transformation ends, 'Siegfried' transforms back into Sieg with his Stats and Skill/Spell/NP Cooldowns the same as they were before he transformed, then his Health is reduced by 100 (Sieg's Health cannot drop below 1 in this way). Cooldown: 3◈ Turns plus the number of Turns Sieg was transformed for, after the transformation ends. Note: New Stats have to be rolled for the transformed Sieg. Any + or - to Sieg's Parameters are carried over to the transformed Sieg.
In one line: Spends a black seal to become Siegfried for a while.
Lore: what it is: By using his Command Spells he temporarily uses Siegfried's inserted heart and transforms into him, downloading the hero's body, experience, abilities and Noble Phantasms for about three minutes.
Lore: how it looks: Special black Command Seals on the back of his left hand.
Icon concept: A black Command Seal on a left hand glowing, a dragon-slayer's greatsword forming. A dark mark and a blade. Black and ember. Reads at 24px as: a dark mark and a blade.

Name: Dead Count Shapeshifter: Dragon Revelation
What it does (system): (Active) When Sieg is summoned, he has three Dragon Revelation Command Spells (DRCS). Usage 1: Used during your Turn. Reduces Sieg's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns and applies Dmg Up (Dragon) for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is increased by 100%; if NP, 50%. Then, this Skill has a 25% chance of consuming one of Sieg's DRCS. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. This usage of this Skill can be used while Sieg has no DRCS left, but NP Cooldown is only reduced by ½◈ Turns, and Dmg Up (Dragon) increases the damage dealt to 'Dragon' Attribute Units by 50%; if NP, 25%.
In one line: Black seals that ready his ultimate and fuel his dragon power.
Lore: what it is: The Dragon Revelation Command Spells, combined with Man-made Hero (False), let him act as a hero or Servant for a short time.
Lore: how it looks: Black Command Seals on his left hand that darken as they are used.
Icon concept: Three black Command Seal strokes on a left hand, one dimming. A three-part dark mark. Black and ember. Reads at 24px as: a dark three-part mark.

Name: Galvanism
What it does (system): (Passive) Granted by Bridal Chest. Whenever Sieg takes MAG damage, his NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns, and the Cooldown of one random Straße/gehen Spell is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns. This Skill is in effect even while Sieg is transformed into Siegfried. This effect is negated while affected with NP Seal.
In one line: Magic hitting him charges his ultimate and spells.
Lore: what it is: A mana-replenishing ability that lets him fire Balmung repeatedly, heal from heart shots and slow the toll of spent Command Spells.
Icon concept: A frog-leg twitch of current through a body, sparks at the joints. A body with sparks. Yellow shock. Reads at 24px as: sparks on a figure.

Name: Straße/gehen: Heilen
What it does (system): Spell. Used during your Turn. Used on an allied Unit within a 3 panel area of himself. Restores the affected Unit's Health by 15% of its maximum value and Agility by 1. If used on himself, his Health is instead restored by 30% of its maximum value and Agility is restored by 2. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.
In one line: A healing spell on an ally nearby.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A green rune glowing over an open hand. A glyph over a palm. Verdant. Reads at 24px as: a green glyph.

Name: Homunculus
What it does (system): (Passive) Has the following effects- 1. All STR damage dealt is increased by 5%. 2. All MAG damage dealt is increased by 10%. 3. Chance of being inflicted with debuffs is reduced by 5%.
In one line: An artificial being: magic blows hit harder, curses land less.
Lore: what it is: A C+ skill from his creation as a homunculus by the Musik family, who borrowed Einzbern techniques; he was born with a personality and strong magecraft talent.
Lore: how it looks: Slender, frail, with dark red ruby eyes and brown hair.
Icon concept: A glass flask holding a curled figure with ruby eyes. A flask with a figure. Glass and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a figure in a flask.

Name: Straße/gehen: Knacken
What it does (system): Spell. Range=3. Used during your Turn on an enemy Unit; or at the start of a Combat Phase on the DU (needs to be within Range). Inflict Def Dwn (Knacken) for 1◈ Turns on the enemy Unit, all damage taken is increased by 50% including NP on the Turn this Spell is used, then its magnitude is reduced to 25% at the end of the Turn the Spell was used. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: A breaking spell that cracks one foe's defences.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A rune cracking a plate of armour. A glyph on a cracked plate. Mana blue and steel. Reads at 24px as: a cracked plate.

Name: Magecraft
What it does (system): Allows the use of Straße/gehen Spells. Only one Straße/gehen Spell can be used per Turn.
In one line: Can cast spells, one per turn.
Lore: what it is: Natural talent of homunculus magic circuits: he understands a target's structure and destroys solids with an opposing composition; Sieg can use nothing else.
Icon concept: A magic circle forming in an open palm. A ring above a hand. Mana blue on night. Reads at 24px as: a blue ring.

Name: Man-made Hero (False)
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 2. Applies Max HpUp for 1◈ Turns, Max Health is increased by 20% of its original value. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Borrows a hero's shape: tougher, and his ultimate charges faster.
Lore: what it is: He is a man-made pseudo-hero thanks to Siegfried's heart and Frankenstein's current; combined with a Dragon Revelation Command Spell he can briefly act as a Servant.
Lore: how it looks: He grows taller and more slender, resembling Saber.
Icon concept: A slender silhouette overlaid by a taller armoured one. Two overlapping figures. Bone and gold. Reads at 24px as: a figure with a taller shadow.

Name: Straße/gehen: Schwert
What it does (system): Spell. Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase. Applies Atk Up to himself for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 35%; if NP, 25%. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.
In one line: A sword spell that sharpens his strikes for a moment.
Lore: what it is: No wiki entry (searched)
Icon concept: A blade of blue light forming over a hand. A glowing blade. Mana blue. Reads at 24px as: a blue blade.

Name: Armor of Fafnir: Blood Armor of the Evil Dragon
What it does (system): (Passive) Has several effects- 1. Damage from all Normal Attacks, (Attack) Skills, and (Damage) Spells received from Units with a STR Rank or MAG Rank of B or lower are completely nullified. Damage from all Normal Attacks, Attack Skills, and Spells that are able to damage Siegfried have their Total damage reduced by 75%. 2. Damage from all damage-dealing Noble Phantasms used on Siegfried with a Rank of B+ or lower is completely nullified. Total Damage from all damage-inflicting Noble Phantasms used on Siegfried which are able to damage him is reduced by 75%. 3. Effects 1 & 2 are ignored/bypassed if the Attack, (Attack) Skill, (Damage) Spell, Noble Phantasm or the AU has an 'Anti-Dragon' effect (i.e. deals extra damage to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute). 4. Effects 1 & 2 is ignored/bypassed if Siegfried is Attacked from behind/his back. If Siegfried takes damage from being Attacked from behind, both his Max Health and current Health are reduced, instead of just current Health. Def Up, Dmg Cut, Invuln, and any other damage reducing effects on Siegfried do not apply if he is Attacked from behind. 5. Effects 1 and 2 are negated if Siegfried is affected by NP Seal.
In one line: Dragon-blood skin: weak attacks do nothing, except at one spot on his back.
Lore: what it is: A constantly active armor from bathing in dragon blood that negates attacks of B rank and below, downgrades A-rank attacks, and rises to B+ against Noble Phantasms.
Lore: how it looks: Radiant silver woven plate armor over skin dyed brown by dragon blood, with a weak spot on his back.
Icon concept: Dragon-blood-dyed skin with a single leaf-shaped bare patch on the back. A back shape with a mark. Bronze-brown and silver. Reads at 24px as: a back with a leaf mark.

Name: Avaricious Gold
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Apply the 'Rheingold' buff for 1◈ Turns, a successful activation of 'Golden Rule' reduces NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns instead of 1 Turn. 2. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. 3. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30%; if NP, 15%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Hoarded gold: his crits ready the ultimate even faster.
Lore: what it is: An A-rank upgrade of Golden Rule: he took the Nibelungs' treasure and a lifetime of wealth, but his Luck suffers for it.
Icon concept: A dragon's hoard of gold coins in a heap. A mound of discs. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold heap.

Name: Balmung: Phantasmal Greatsword, Felling of the Sky Demon
What it does (system): Base Attack (MAG) is used. Hits a 5x3 or 3x5 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Siegfried for 5x damage, damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is further increased by 200%. Then, if Siegfried had any 'Anti-Dragon' effects (any buffs/effects which increase damage dealt/reduce damage taken from 'Dragon' Attribute Units), apply NP Regen (Balmung) to Siegfried for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn for every Anti-Dragon effect on himself. Note: Passive Anti-Dragon effects do not count. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.
In one line: Releases a twilight wave from his greatsword across an area.
Lore: what it is: A cursed holy sword that slew the dragon, unleashing a wide-range attack with extra damage against dragon-attribute foes.
Lore: how it looks: Phantasmal greatsword with a blue hilt jewel that glows with a twilight aura when released.
Icon concept: A greatsword with a blue hilt jewel, unleashing a fan of twilight light. A blade under a wide arc. Blue jewel, amber twilight. Reads at 24px as: a blade under an arc.

Name: Dragon Slayer
What it does (system): (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is increased by 20%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies the following effects- 1. Applies Ward (Dragon) for 1◈ Turns, all damage received from Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is reduced by 30%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Dragon) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Dragon' Attribute is further increased by 60%. 3. Applies Atk Up for ⅓◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 60%; if NP, 40%. Cooldown: 4◈-⅔◈ Turns.
In one line: A dragon slayer: hurts dragons more and guards against them.
Lore: what it is: A skill gained by those who killed a dragon-kind, greatly boosting offence and defence against dragons; the slaying anecdote itself turned into a skill.
Icon concept: A sword through a dragon's skull. A blade through a horned shape. Steel and ember. Reads at 24px as: a blade in a skull.

Name: Curse of Separation
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts for 1◈ Turns, when Sita is defeated she is revived with 100 Health. 2. Restore Sita's Health by 25% of its maximum value. 3. Applies Regen to herself for 1◈ Turns, Sita's Health is restored by 5% of its maximum value at the end of her Turn, at the end of a Turn she Acts, and at the end of the Round. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Survives a killing blow, heals, and draws strength from the curse.
Lore: what it is: Rama was cursed for killing the monkey Bali, so he and Sita can never meet; Sita is not cursed herself but is affected by it.
Icon concept: Two hands reaching for each other, a crack between them. Two hands and a gap. Gold and crimson. Reads at 24px as: two hands apart.

Name: Goddess's Divine Core
What it does (system): (Passive 1) All damage dealt is increased by 60 including NP. (Passive 2) Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is decreased by 20%. (Passive 3) Whenever Sita uses a Skill, apply the 'Janaka' buff to herself for 1◈ Turns, its effects are as follows- When Sita performs a Normal Attack, it uses her Base Attack (STR) and 20% of her Base Attack (MAG) combined (i.e. 75+40=115), the amount of Base Attack (MAG) used increases by 20% for each 'Janaka' buff on Sita; while the effect of Magic Resistance is reduced to X%, where X%=the amount of Base Attack (MAG) used. Whenever the 'Janaka' buff is applied to herself, the duration of all 'Janaka' buffs on herself are reset. This Skill counts as 'Divinity'.
In one line: A goddess's core: every hit is stronger, and curses miss more.
Lore: what it is: Reflects Rama as an avatar of Vishnu and Sita as an avatar of Lakshmi, Vishnu's wife.
Icon concept: A glowing seed-like core inside a lotus petal. A bright dot in a petal. White-gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a dot in a petal.

Name: Haradhanu Janaka: Peerless Bow of Reminiscence
What it does (system): Range=7. Base Attack (MAG) is used. First, removes all debuffs from Sita, then deals 3.5x damage. Next, apply Heal Up for 1◈ Turns to Sita, when Sita's Health is restored, the amount restored is increased by 50%. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns.
In one line: Clears her curses, fires a long shot, then heals better.
Lore: what it is: Shiva's bow, passed down through King Janaka's line, that only Sita could lift as a child and that Rama later snapped; she can string it using another Rama's power.
Icon concept: A heavy bow drawn, a single arrow of gentle gold light. A bow arc. Gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: a bow.

Name: Jewel of the Earth
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of herself. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is reduced by 20%; if NP, 10%; and applies Debuff Immune for 1◈ Turns, 2 times; does not affect Instakill, Death, and Erase. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Allies near her take less damage and resist curses.
Lore: what it is: From the tale of her appearing at the tip of her father's spade; the earth loves and protects her.
Icon concept: A glowing gem rising out of a furrow in the earth. A gem over a line. Verdant and gold. Reads at 24px as: a gem on the ground.

Name: Pilgrimage in Agni Pariksha
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Decoy to herself for ⅔◈ Turns. 2. Applies Invuln to herself for 1◈ Turns, 3 times. 3. Applies Burn Immune to herself for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: Walks through fire unharmed: draws attacks and shrugs off burns.
Lore: what it is: From the story of Sita entering fire to prove her purity, and being burned by no flame.
Icon concept: A woman walking through a wall of flame untouched. A figure in fire. Ember and white. Reads at 24px as: a figure in flame.

Name: Summoning: Elder Horror
What it does (system): Spell. Can be used as a Counter. Summons an Elder Horror on a panel next to Gilles. Counts as Gilles' Attack for the Turn. The Elder Horror has 300 Health, 13 Agility, 7 Luck, Range=2, MOV=4 and Base Attack (STR) is 125, Detect=3 panels. Elder Horrors have the 'Dark (Outsider)' Attribute. Elder Horrors do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn. The same Elder Horror can only Move/Attack once per Turn. When an Elder Horror is defeated, Gilles rolls a four-sided die. If a 3 is rolled, the defeated Elder Horror turns into three new Horrors. This effect does not activate if the Elder Horror was defeated with Light damage or an Attack that deals extra damage to 'Dark' or 'Outsider' Attribute Units. Enemy Units cannot Attack Gilles or his Master if there are any Elder Horrors directly next to them. Cannot be used if Prelati's Spellbook is on Cooldown. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Summoning: Horror. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: Calls up one great sea horror next to him.
Lore: what it is: Summoning of deep-sea water demons and a massive evil god from another world through Prelati's Spellbook.
Icon concept: Base: a large tentacled horror rising from a circle. Accent: the circle is drawn from his spellbook as Caster, and from his sword's tip as Saber. Reads at 24px as: one big mass in a ring.

Name: Summoning: Horrors
What it does (system): Spell. Can be used as a Counter. Roll a four-sided die. The number rolled is the number of Horrors summoned by Gilles (they will appear within a 5x5 panel area around Gilles). Counts as Gilles' Attack for the Turn. Horrors have 100 Health, 10 Agility, 5 Luck, Range=1, MOV=3 and Base Attack (STR) is 100, Detect=2 panels. Horrors have the 'Dark (Outsider)' Attribute. Horrors do not count towards the number of Units that Move and/or Attack during your Turn. The same Horror can only Move/Attack once per Turn. When a Horror is defeated, Gilles Flips a Coin. If Heads, the defeated Horror turns into two new Horrors. This effect does not activate if the Horror was defeated with Light damage or an Attack that deals extra damage to 'Dark' or 'Outsider' Attribute Units. Enemy Units cannot Attack Gilles or his Master if there are any Horrors directly next to them. Cannot be used on the same Turn as Summoning: Elder Horror. Cannot be used if Prelati's Spellbook is on Cooldown. Cooldown: (Number of Horrors x ⅔◈) Turns.
In one line: Calls up a handful of small horrors around him.
Lore: what it is: Summoning of deep-sea water demons and familiar horrors from another world through Prelati's Spellbook.
Icon concept: Base: several small tentacled horrors crawling from circles. Accent: as for Elder Horror. Reads at 24px as: small masses in rings.

Name: Yata no Kagami: Hakkon Jourai・Dainisshō
What it does (system): Damage Spell. Can only be used when Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi・Yata no Kagami is Active. Hits a 7x7 panel area in any non-diagonal direction next to Tamamo; if the Region is Japan, it hits a 9x9 panel area instead. The effects are as follows, in order 1. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Poison, Nature damage. 2. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Disable for 1◈ Turns, Ice damage. 3. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Sap for 1◈ Turns, Wind damage. 4. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Shock for 1◈ Turns, Lightning damage. 5. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Slow for 1◈ Turns, Water damage. 6. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Immobilize for 1◈ Turns, Earth damage. 7. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Blind for 1◈ Turns, Light damage. 8. Hits a random enemy Unit within the Spell area for 50% damage with a 25% chance of inflicting Curse, Dark damage. 9. Then, deals 2x damage to all enemy Units within the Spell area and inflicts Burn for 2◈ Turns, Fire damage. When this Spell is used, Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi・Yata no Kagami is forcibly ended at the end of the Turn, and its Cooldown is increased by an additional 1◈ Turns. This Damage Spell is categorized as Noble Phantasm.
In one line: Under the sacred mirror, a great sun blast over a wide area.
Lore: what it is: Yata no Kagami (mode of Eightfold Blessing of Amaterasu): the mirror-shaped Noble Phantasm, the temporarily released form of the sacred treasure Tamamo Shizuishi. In FGO the NP reduces party cooldowns and recovers HP.
Lore: how it looks: A Noble Phantasm in the shape of a mirror.
Icon concept: Base: the Yata mirror. Accent: a blazing sun bursting from its face. Reads at 24px as: a mirror with a sun.

Name: Jusō・Enten
What it does (system): Mantra: Fiery Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 25% extra damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Burn for 2◈ Turns. Fire damage. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Hyōten, Mitten, or Raitei is on Cooldown.
In one line: A fire mantra that may set the target burning.
Lore: what it is: Jusō Enten (Curse: Fiery Heaven) is a fire spell; in Extra it deals magic damage and Stun against Break.
Lore: how it looks: A controllable spurt of flames in Extella Link.
Icon concept: A paper talisman bursting into fox-fire. A slip with a flame. Ember. Reads at 24px as: a burning slip.

Name: Fox's Wedding
What it does (system): (Active) Range=3. Used on an allied Unit. Has the following effects- 1. Restores its Health by 20% of its maximum value and restores its Luck by 3 (5 Luck instead if used on her Master). 2. Applies Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 50%; if NP, 30%. 3. If the affected Unit is Tamamo's Master or is Tamamo while her Master is within a 2 panel area of herself, apply the Fox Spouse buff to her Master for 1◈ Turns, the Master cannot be Overpowered and Underpowered by Servants. The 'Fox Spouse' buff is Unremovable. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: A sun shower blessing that heals an ally and restores luck.
Lore: what it is: An Item Construction skill reworked by Tamamo after seeing Suzuka Gozen's Noble Phantasm: she declares a wedding one-sidedly, showering allies with blessings and souvenirs.
Icon concept: Rain falling through sunlight with a fox's shadow. Drops and rays. Gold and verdant. Reads at 24px as: sunlit rain.

Name: Tokoyo Sakisaku Daisakkai・Higanbana Sesshoseki
What it does (system): Rank ?. Red Spider Lily Killing Stone. Range=1. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 2x damage. Has 2 extra effects depending on the DU's END Rank and MAG Rank. 1. Inflicts Stage X Curse on the DU, X being: MAG Rank EX, A: 1; B, C: 2; D, E: 3. 2. Inflicts Stage X Poison on the DU, X being: END Rank EX, A: 1; B, C: 2; D, E: 3. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Note: When this NP is used, Tamamo's Master loses Health equal to if a Rank E Noble Phantasm was used.
In one line: The killing stone curses its target, worse for the frail.
Lore: what it is: The Red Spider Lily Killing Stone skill, dealing magic damage and Poison, usable only when her HP is below 30% in game.
Icon concept: A red spider lily blooming from a cracked stone. A spiky flower on a rock. Crimson and grey. Reads at 24px as: a red spiky flower.

Name: Jusō・Hyōten
What it does (system): Mantra: Frigid Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 25% extra damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Disable for 1◈ Turns. Ice damage. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Enten, Mitten, or Raitei is on Cooldown.
In one line: An ice mantra that may disable the target.
Lore: what it is: Jusō Hyōten (Curse: Frigid Heaven) is an ice spell; in Extra it deals magic damage and Stun against Attack.
Lore: how it looks: Five balls of ice shoot forward in Extella Link.
Icon concept: Five balls of ice shooting from a talisman. A slip with dots. Ice white. Reads at 24px as: a slip with white dots.

Name: Jusō・Kokutendō
What it does (system): Mantra: Aphotic Cave. Spell. Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase when Attacked. Tamamo enters the Aphotic state for ⅓◈ Turns. This effect is neither a buff or a debuff and is Unremovable; the effects of the 'Aphotic' state are as follows- 1. Gains the Decoy effect. 2. Cannot Evade and Dodge/Substitution has no effect. 3. Tamamo automatically Blocks every Attack received. 4. All damage taken is reduced by 30%; if NP, 15%. 5. Whenever Tamamo is Attacked while in the 'Aphotic' State, at the end of the Damage Step, reduce her Spell Cooldown by ⅓◈ Turns (including this Spell!). If all Spells are not in Cooldown, then NP Cooldown is reduced by ⅓◈ Turns. If all Spells and NP are not in Cooldown, then gain the Dmg Up (Aphotic) buff for 1 time, damage dealt by the next Attack which deals MAG damage is increased by 15% including NP. Dmg Up (Aphotic) can stack and is Unremovable. This Spell cannot be used if Tamamo is already in the 'Aphotic' state. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns.
In one line: Slips into a lightless state to avoid harm.
Lore: what it is: Jusō Kokutendō (Mantra: Aphotic Cave) is a self-applied skill that lowers damage and absorbs MP; in Extella Link it is a counter guard state.
Icon concept: A dark cave mouth swallowing a fox's tail. A black arch. Black and violet. Reads at 24px as: a dark arch.

Name: Jusō・Kōnisshō
What it does (system): Mantra: Boundless Sunlight. Spell. Used during your Turn. Range=3. Used on an enemy Unit within Range, increases its NP Cooldown by 3◈ Turns (cannot exceed max Cooldown in this way), then Tamamo gains 2 Mantra Tokens. After that, apply NP DmUp for 1◈ Turns to all other allied Units within a 2 panel area around Tamamo, NP damage dealt is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: A sunlight mantra that badly delays a foe's ultimate.
Lore: what it is: Mantra: Boundless Sunlight. In FGO, it may reduce an enemy's NP gauge by 1 and raises party NP damage except Tamamo's own.
Icon concept: A sun disc stamped on a talisman, its light pinning a shadow. A slip with a sun. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a slip with a sun.

Name: Jusō・Kūretsu Daimitten
What it does (system): Mantra: Void Cleft Great Chaos Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 2x damage with a 75% chance of inflicting Stun for 1◈ Turns. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: A chaotic mantra that hits hard and likely stuns.
Lore: what it is: Her 'final secret technique', a void-magic curse she used to lock Suzuka Gozen in place.
Icon concept: A void crack splitting the air, wind howling out. A jagged split. Violet and teal. Reads at 24px as: a jagged crack.

Name: Jusō・Mitten
What it does (system): Mantra: Chaos Heaven. Damage Spell. Deals 25% extra damage that has the Pierce effect and Break (+50%dm) effect. Wind damage. Cooldown: 1◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Enten, Hyōten, or Raitei is on Cooldown.
In one line: A wind mantra that pierces and breaks defences.
Lore: what it is: Jusō Mitten (Curse: Chaos Heaven) is an air spell; in Extra it deals magic damage and Stun against Guard.
Lore: how it looks: A tornado surrounding her in Extella Link.
Icon concept: A tornado spiralling from a talisman. A funnel. Teal. Reads at 24px as: a funnel.

Name: Polygamist Castration Fist
What it does (system): Attack Skill. Range=2. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 3x damage. If the Unit is Male, deal 9x damage instead, and has a 90% chance of inflicting Stun (Balls) for 1◈ Turns if damage was dealt- Not affected by any effects which modify chance of inflicting/receiving debuffs as well as Debuff Immune, even those which specifically resist Bind effects. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: A brutal kick combo, devastating against men.
Lore: what it is: Her kick technique that critically strikes male enemies.
Lore: how it looks: Repeated front kicks, a somersault kick and a finishing jump kick.
Icon concept: A fox-eared figure mid jump kick, motion lines behind. A leaping kick shape. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a flying kick.

Name: Jusō・Raitei
What it does (system): Mantra: Thunderclap. Damage Spell. Hits a 3x3 panel area within Range for 25% extra damage with a 50% chance of inflicting Shock for 2◈ Turns. Lightning damage. Tamamo cannot be within the Spell area. Cooldown: 2◈ Turns. Cannot be used if Enten, Hyōten, or Mitten is on Cooldown.
In one line: A thunder mantra that may shock everyone in an area.
Lore: what it is: Jusō Raitei (Curse: Thunderclap) is a restriction spell that fires a cursed exploding ball, stunning enemies in the blast.
Icon concept: A cursed ball of lightning bursting. A crackling sphere. Yellow shock. Reads at 24px as: a lightning ball.

Name: Shapeshift
What it does (system): (Passive) All damage taken is reduced by 30%; if NP, 15%.
In one line: A shapeshifter's body: takes less damage.
Lore: what it is: As a kitsune she can change appearance or species at will, though a traumatic past incarnation makes her seldom use it.
Icon concept: A figure dissolving into pages and reforming. A silhouette of flying sheets. Bone and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure of pages.

Name: Witchcraft
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Tamamo's Attacks which use Base Attack (MAG) ignore Magic Resistance. Negated while affected by Skill Seal or Silence. (Passive 2) When Tamamo uses a Mantra Spell other than Jusō: Kōnisshō, Jusō・Kokutendō, and Jusō・Kūretsu Daimitten while she has any Mantra Tokens, remove one Mantra Token from herself and the Mantra Spell that she used does not enter Cooldown. The maximum number of Mantra Tokens Tamamo can have is 3.
In one line: Her magic ignores magic resistance.
Lore: what it is: Her Curse Arts recompose the raw materials of her own body rather than her surroundings, tied to Dakiniten methods, and she rarely uses these formidable skills.
Icon concept: A fox mask with nine tails fanning behind it. A mask and tails. Gold and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a fan of tails.

Name: Suiten Nikkou Amaterasu Yanoshisu Ishi・Yata no Kagami
What it does (system): (Non-damaging) Eightfold Blessings of Amaterasu on the Weight Stone under the Sunlit Watery Heavens. Affects a 5x5 panel area around Tamamo, this area will be termed as the 'Amaterasu Area'. Tamamo cannot leave the Amaterasu Area. Increases Tamamo's Range by 1 for the NP duration. If the Region is Japan, the Amaterasu Area is 7x7 instead, and Tamamo's Range is increased by 2. This NP has the following effects- 1. All allied Units within the Amaterasu Area upon activation have their Health and Agility and Luck restored by 30% of their maximum values. 2. Reduces Skill, Spell, and NP Cooldown of all allied Units within the Amaterasu Area upon activation by 1◈ Turns (excluding this NP's own Cooldown). 3. Increases damage dealt by all allied Units within the Amaterasu Area. MAG damage dealt is increased by 100%, while STR damage dealt is increased by 50%. Applies to Noble Phantasm as well. 4. Allied Masters' ZON do not apply to their Servants within the Amaterasu Area. 5. The Sustainability of allied Free Servants do not decrease when they are within the Amaterasu Area. 6. All effects of Servants that would reduce its Master's Health when used/it takes effect is halved including Noble Phantasm usage. 7. The maximum number of Mantra Tokens she can hold is increased to 6, then she gains Mantra Tokens up to the maximum amount. 8. Tamamo's Divinity Skill becomes activated. 9. If Tamamo is defeated, this NP is forcefully ended at the end of the Turn. This Noble Phantasm lasts for 2◈ Turns (3◈ Turns if the Region is Japan). Cooldown: 4◈ Turns after it ends.
In one line: Raises a sacred mirror's field that powers her spells within it.
Lore: what it is: Her mirror, one of the Japanese sacred treasures tied to Amaterasu, that raises a barrier cutting off Tokoyo's logic and making magic cost nothing inside.
Lore: how it looks: A mirror; the in-game version is a barrier.
Icon concept: A round bronze mirror with a sun rising behind it. A disc with rays. Bronze and gold. Reads at 24px as: a bronze disc.

Name: Yata Strike
What it does (system): Attack Skill. Can be used instead of a Normal Attack and is categorized as one. Range=2. Deals 10 Fixed STR damage, Total Damage dealt is multiplied by X, X = the number rolled on an eight-sided die. 1. For every time this Attack Skill does not Crit, increase the Crit Chance of this Attack Skill by 10%. Reset the counter after it Crits. 2. If this Attack Skill is a Crit, it deals 15 STR damage instead of 10.
In one line: A swing of the mirror for a random burst of damage.
Lore: what it is: Yata no Kagami (mode of Eightfold Blessing of Amaterasu): the mirror-shaped Noble Phantasm, the temporarily released form of the sacred treasure Tamamo Shizuishi. In FGO the NP reduces party cooldowns and recovers HP.
Lore: how it looks: A Noble Phantasm in the shape of a mirror.
Icon concept: Base: the Yata mirror. Accent: swung in an arc, a die tumbling. Reads at 24px as: a mirror in an arc.

Name: Bloodsucking
What it does (system): (Active) Range=1. Used on an enemy Unit. Increase its NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns, and reduce Vlad's NP Cooldown by 1◈ Turns. If Mad Enhancement is Active, the Range of this Skill is increased by 1, but the chance of increasing the DU's NP Cooldown is reduced by 20%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: Drinks a foe's blood, delaying their ultimate and readying his.
Lore: what it is: Vampiric ability to enslave others, even Servants, by drinking their blood; it counts as affection, not an attack, so it cannot be defended against.
Icon concept: Two fangs with a drop of blood between them. Two points and a drop. Bone and crimson. Reads at 24px as: fangs and a drop.

Name: Fearsome Immortal
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Guts (Fearsome) to Vlad for ⅓◈ Turns, when Vlad is defeated he is revived with 20% of his Max Health. This Guts buff stacks with other normal Guts buffs. 2. Applies Guts to Vlad for 1◈+⅔◈ Turns, when Vlad is defeated he is revived with 20% of his Max Health. 3. Applies NP Regen for 1◈ Turns, NP Cooldown is reduced by 1 Turn at the end of every Turn. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Refuses to stay dead: survives a killing blow.
Lore: what it is: A Grand Order upgrade of Battle Continuation, giving great resilience and survivability.
Icon concept: A shadowy figure rising from a coffin. A figure over a box. Black and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a figure rising.

Name: Kazıklı Bey: Bloodstained King Demon
What it does (system): Range=3. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 3.5x damage plus 100 and inflicts Curse on the DU. Then, has the following effects- 1. Inflicts Def Dwn (A) for 1◈ Turns to the DU, all damage taken is increased by 20%; and Luck is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. 2. Applies S.Crit Up to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 10%. Cooldown: 6◈+⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Stakes burst from his body, cursing and breaking the target.
Lore: what it is: Berserker's version of the impaling Noble Phantasm: it can destroy one Servant by shooting stakes from inside his own body, also usable under Legend of Dracula.
Lore: how it looks: Stakes shot from his body made of wood, bone, flesh, shadow and hair.
Icon concept: Stakes of bone and shadow bursting outward from a body. Spikes radiating. Black and crimson. Reads at 24px as: radiating spikes.

Name: Legend of Dracula: The Succession of Blood
What it does (system): (Passive) Applies the following effects to Vlad- 1. Applies the 'Dark (Vampire)' Attribute to Vlad. 2. Vlad restores 100 Health and 1 Agility at the end of any Turn he Acts during a Night Round. 3. Every time Vlad deals damage to a Unit, he heals 100 Health and 1 Agility. Each time he kills a non-Civilian Unit, his Health and Agility is restored by 25% of their maximum values. (Active/Non-damaging) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. If Vlad has the Def Up (Shapeshift) buff and/or the Atk Up (Shapeshift) buff, the duration of those buffs is extended by 1◈ Turns. 2. Vlad gains the Dracula effect for 1◈ Turns, its effects are as follows- Doubles the magnitude of 'Shapeshift's' Passive effect, the Def Up (Shapeshift) buff, and the Atk Up (Shapeshift) buff. The 'Dracula' effect is neither a buff or debuff and is Unremovable (see the next line for the exception). 3. If this Skill is used during a 'Day' Round, Vlad does not gain the 'Dracula' effect. If the Round changes from Night to Day while Vlad has the 'Dracula' effect, it is removed from him at the start of the Day Round. 4. Applies Atk Up (Shapeshift) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 10%; if NP, 5%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. Does not consume his Master's Health as a cost when used.
In one line: Becomes the vampire: heals by night and grows monstrous.
Lore: what it is: By becoming Dracula he loses other skills and Noble Phantasms but gains huge physical power, mist and animal forms, healing and charming eyes, plus sunlight and holy weaknesses.
Lore: how it looks: Blood-red eyes, fangs, claws, torn aristocratic clothes, flesh like shadow.
Icon concept: Base: a bat-winged silhouette with blood-red eyes. Accent: as Berserker, claws bared and clothes torn. Reads at 24px as: a winged figure with red eyes.

Name: Shapeshift
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Reduces all damage received by 10%; if NP, 5%. (Active) Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Process when Vlad is Attacked. Applies Def Up (Shapeshift) for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is further reduced by 10%; if NP, 5%. Def Up (Shapeshift) does not stack. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns. (Passive 2) If this Skill is used while Vlad has any Def Up (Shapeshift) and/or Atk Up (Shapeshift) buffs, their duration is reset to 1◈ Turns.
In one line: A shapeshifter's body: takes less damage, more on demand.
Lore: what it is: A vampiric ability to turn into mist or countless bats, useful in melee but weak against wide-area attacks.
Icon concept: A figure dissolving into pages and reforming. A silhouette of flying sheets. Bone and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure of pages.

Name: Demonic Defender of the State
What it does (system): (Passive) When Vlad III (Lancer) is summoned, the player with Vlad marks out a 9x9 panel area on the half of the board nearer to or around Vlad's Home Base. This area cannot intersect the Home Base of other Players. This area will be known as 'Wallachia'. Has the following effects- 1. As long as Vlad is within Wallachia, all damage taken is reduced by 50%; if NP, 25%. 2. As long as Vlad is within Wallachia, all STR damage dealt is increased by 100% including NP; if MAG damage, 50%. 3. Vlad's Sustainability does not decrease as long as he is within Wallachia, and his Master's ZON is ignored. 4. Wallachia functions as a second Home Base for Vlad only. On panels where his actual Home Base and Wallachia overlap, the end-of-the-Round healing does not stack. Note: If Wallachia would intersect the Home Base of another Player no matter where it is placed, then the shape of the Wallachia area is reduced to exclude panels which would intersect the Home Base of another Player.
In one line: Marks his homeland on the field; inside it he is far stronger.
Lore: what it is: The ability to mark a region as his dominion by securing its leylines; within it he fights with a Mad Enhancement A-like bonus and Kazikli Bey becomes usable.
Icon concept: A crowned shield over a marked square of land. A shield over a square. Crimson and gold. Reads at 24px as: a shield on a square.

Name: Kazıklı Bey (Execution)
What it does (system): (Active 2) Used during your Turn, or at the start or end of a Combat Process involving Vlad. Affects all Units with Kazıklı stacks within a 3 panel area of himself. Those Units receive Y damage, where Y being 50 * the number of Kazıklı stacks on each Unit respectively; then inflict Curse to the affected Units, and remove all Kazıklı stacks from the affected Units. This damage has the Pierce and Ignore Def effects. Counts as Vlad's Attack for the Turn if used during his Turn. If this NP is used within the Wallachia, Y is 100 * the number of Kazıklı stacks on the respective affected Units who are also within Wallachia (those outside of it use the original calculation instead, if any). If this NP is used at the start of a Combat Process where Vlad is receiving the Attack; the AU's Attack is cancelled, then Vlad can Counter if the enemy Unit is within Range. If this NP is used at the end of a Combat Process where Vlad performed the Attack; the DU cannot Counter Vlad's Attack. Can only be used once per Round. Does not reduce his Master's Health as a cost when used. Note: Damage from this NP is not affected by any damage-modifying effects on Vlad.
In one line: Raises stakes under everyone he has marked, damaging them all.
Lore: what it is: The Lord of Execution form: up to 20,000 stakes in his domain, with stakes bursting from within an enemy his spear strikes.
Lore: how it looks: Long stakes several meters tall rising from the ground and hoisting victims.
Icon concept: Base: rows of stakes. Accent: they burst up together under several marked figures. Reads at 24px as: many spikes rising.

Name: Kazıklı Bey: The Lord of Execution
What it does (system): (Passive) Whenever Vlad successfully deals damage to a Unit with a Normal Attack, apply one Kazıklı stack to the DU at the end of the Damage Step. Kazıklı stacks are categorized as a debuff, the chance of a Kazıklı stack being removed is reduced by 50%. (Active 1) Used during your Turn. This Noble Phantasm can only be used within Wallachia. When this Noble Phantasm is used, it becomes Activated for ⅔◈ Turns and has the following effects- While Kazıklı Bey is Activated, at the end of every Turn Vlad Acts and at the end of the Round, all enemy Units within the NP area roll a six-sided die respectively. They will then respectively receive X STR damage, X being the number rolled * 100, if the NP is not Evaded. Damaged Units will then be inflicted with Curse. This NP is able to damage Masters even if their respective Servant is within a 2 panel area of them. Damage from this NP has the Ignore Def effect and also ignores Block, but Units with the Invuln and Anti-Purge buffs will not take damage. Cooldown: 6◈ Turns. (Active 2) Kazıklı Bey (Execution). Note: Damage from both (Active 1) and (Active 2) of this NP are not affected by any damage-modifying effects on Vlad.
In one line: Each of his blows plants a mark that a later execution will use.
Lore: what it is: A Noble Phantasm sublimating the legend of the impaled soldiers shown to Mehmed II, filling his domain with attacking and blocking stakes.
Lore: how it looks: Long stakes several meters tall sprouting from the earth.
Icon concept: A single tall stake rising from the ground. A tall spike. Dark wood and crimson. Reads at 24px as: one tall spike.

Name: Legend of Dracula: The Succession of Blood
What it does (system): (Activation/Passive) In order to use this Noble Phantasm, Vlad's Master has to use a Command Spell. However, if the Master is within Wallachia when it is activated, Vlad will immediately kill his Master after this NP is activated. Cannot be deactivated after it is used. Permanently applies the following effects to Vlad- 1. Vlad gains the 'Dark (Vampire)' Attribute. 2. During a Night Round, Vlad heals 100 Health and 1 Agility at the end of his Turn, at the end of any Turn he Acts, and at the end of the Round. 3. Each time Vlad deals damage to a Unit, he heals 100 Health and 1 Agility (no effect if no damage is dealt). Each time he defeats a Unit, his Health and Agility is restored by 25% of their maximum values. However, if he defeats a Civilian, he only heals 100 Health and 1 Agility. 4. The magnitude of Shapeshift is doubled. 5. Kazıklı Bey is unusable and has no effects. Magic Resistance is disabled. 6. Vlad will always Attack (and Move towards) the closest Unit, including allied Units. 7. Range is increased by 1 panel, and number of targets is increased by 1. Vlad can Move to any unoccupied panel while Moving, regardless of obstacles (but still cannot enter the area around an enemy Master). 8. Base Attack (STR) is increased by 75. 9. Whenever Vlad performs an Evade roll, reduce the value rolled by 4. Does not affect non-Evade Agility Checks. 10. Total Fire damage taken is increased by 25%. See Legend of Dracula (Activated).
In one line: With a Command Seal, he becomes the vampire Dracula.
Lore: what it is: The Dracula legend ability that turns him into a monster-vampire, sealing his normal skills and Noble Phantasms and granting vampire powers.
Lore: how it looks: Blood-red eyes, fangs, claws, torn clothes, shadow-like flesh.
Icon concept: Base: a bat-winged silhouette with blood-red eyes. Accent: as Lancer, a royal cloak still on the shoulders. Reads at 24px as: a winged figure with red eyes.

Name: Shapeshift
What it does (system): (Passive) All damage taken is reduced by 10%; if NP, 5%. (Active) Used during your Turn or at the start of a Combat Phase when Vlad is Attacked. Applies Def Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage taken is further reduced by 10%; if NP, 5%. Cooldown: 3◈ Turns.
In one line: A shapeshifter's body: takes less damage, more on demand.
Lore: what it is: A vampiric ability to turn into mist or countless bats, useful in melee but weak against wide-area attacks.
Icon concept: A figure dissolving into pages and reforming. A silhouette of flying sheets. Bone and blue. Reads at 24px as: a figure of pages.

Name: [Vorpal Blade]
What it does (system): When Equipped, increase the Unit's Base Attack (STR) by 50, but Range is reduced to 1 panel; and Normal Attack damage dealt to Units with the 'Demonic' Attribute is increased by 50%. The above Stat boosts do not affect NP & Attacks Categorized as NP. Normal Attacks with this Item Equipped use Base Attack (STR). A Master with this Item Equipped cannot be Underpowered by Servants. When the Jabberwock is Attacked by this Equipped Item, it receives 3x damage instead of 50% extra damage due to having the 'Demonic' Attribute, and the lifesteal effect is permanently removed from the Jabberwock; then the Vorpal Blade breaks and can no longer be used. Cannot be obtained by Nursery or her Master.
In one line: A short beheading blade: much stronger hits at close range, deadly to demons.
Lore: what it is: A Conceptual Weapon from Fate/EXTRA, made by the alchemist Rani VIII; it inhibits (weakens) the enemy's strength, and was transmuted from a malachite.
Icon concept: A crescent-curved short blade with a checkerboard grip, its edge catching a thin white line of light. A crescent hook. Steel and bone ink, a white edge glint. Reads at 24px as: a white crescent.

Name: Doppelganger
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. When this Skill is used, Yan Qing can disguise himself as any other character (figurine), including Masters and Servants. However, it is only the appearance. All of Yan Qing's Parameters and Stats remain the same. Skills and Noble Phantasms except Presence Concealment cannot be used while Doppelganger is Active. Can be deactivated at any time; and is automatically deactivated when Yan Qing takes damage equal to 10% of his Max Health or more in one Attack. When Doppelganger is manually deactivated by Yan Qing, apply the following effects to himself- 1. Restore 3 Agility. 2. Apply Atk Up for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt is increased by 30% after calculation; if NP, 20%. 3. Apply Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 30%. 4. Apply Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 30% after calculation. Cooldown: 4◈-⅓◈ Turns after deactivation. Note: Espionage cannot be used if Doppelganger is Active and vice versa.
In one line: Disguises himself as any other figure on the field.
Lore: what it is: An EX transformation skill that dilutes his self so he can copy others' looks and some Skills, but not Noble Phantasms.
Icon concept: A mask held up to a face, a second face showing behind. A face and a mask. Bone and teal. Reads at 24px as: a mask and a face.

Name: Espionage
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Crit Up for 1◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 40%. 2. Applies the Espionage buff for 1◈ Turns, Yan Qing's Presence Concealment Rank is increased from C to A. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: A spy's craft: crits more and stays hidden while acting.
Lore: what it is: An A-rank skill for infiltrating enemy organisations and gaining powerful trust, passing information through illegal channels.
Icon concept: An eye peering through a gap in a curtain. An eye in a slit. Teal. Reads at 24px as: an eye in a gap.

Name: Yan Qing Fist
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Has the following effects- 1. Applies Crit Up for ⅓◈ Turns, Crit Chance is increased by 60%. 2. Applies Dmg Up (Lawful) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Lawful' Alignment is increased by 30%. 3.
