Applies Dmg Up (Evil) for 1◈ Turns, all damage dealt to Units with the 'Evil' Alignment is increased by 30%. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns.
In one line: His fighting style: huge crit chance and more against the lawful.
Lore: what it is: The Grand Order upgrade of Chinese Boxing, an EX-rank martial art he is believed to have originated.
Icon concept: A fist with a tiger tattoo striking. A fist with stripes. Ink and gold. Reads at 24px as: a striped fist.

Name: Shí Miàn Mái Fú: Xíng Rú Wú Yǐng
What it does (system): Ambushed from Ten Sides - As If There Was No Shadow. Base Attack (STR) is used. Deals 5x damage, then roll 2 four-sided dice and apply the following effects, depending on the numbers rolled- 1. Inflict Def Dwn (C) for 1◈ Turns on the DU, all damage taken is increased by 20%; and Agility is reduced by 1 whenever damage is received from an Attack. 2. Inflict Crit Dwn for 1◈ Turns on the DU, Crit Chance is reduced by 40%. 3. Applies Crit DmUp for 1◈ Turns to himself, Crit Damage dealt is increased by 50%. If the second die is a duplicate number, reroll it until the number is not a duplicate. If a 4 is rolled on any of the dice, apply all three effects instead. Cooldown: 8◈ Turns.
In one line: Ambush from ten sides: a savage strike plus random extra effects.
Lore: what it is: Clone strikes through the footwork of Yan Qing Quan: not sorcery, but to observers an imperceptible stepping followed by multiple blows.
Icon concept: Ten shadow fists surrounding one point. A ring of fists. Black and teal. Reads at 24px as: a ring of fists.

Name: Ruffian
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Crit Damage dealt is increased by 15%. (Passive 2) Whenever Yan Qing deals damage with an Attack, he can spend X Agility to increase the damage dealt. For every Agility point spent in this way, damage dealt is increased by 5%. Cannot be used with Noble Phantasm.
In one line: A brawler's grit: harder crits, and can burn footing for more damage.
Lore: what it is: A composite of Riding and Independent Action that grows stronger at banquets and similar occasions.
Icon concept: A bandaged fist with a scrape. A wrapped fist. Bone and crimson. Reads at 24px as: a wrapped fist.

Name: Skillful Star
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Inflicts Crit Dwn on himself for this Turn, Crit Chance is reduced by 50%; then apply S.Crit Up for 1◈ Turns to all allied Units within a 2 panel area of himself except himself, Crit Chance is increased by 15%. Cooldown: 3◈-⅓◈ Turns.
In one line: Gives up his own crits so nearby allies crit more.
Lore: what it is: Marks him as one of the 108 Stars of Destiny, reborn as heroes; he was the Skillful Star, skilled at the exquisite, and bears a calamitous karmic burden.
Icon concept: A star passed from one open hand to another. Two hands and a star. Gold. Reads at 24px as: a star between hands.

Name: Zhōng Guó Quán Fǎ
What it does (system): (Passive) Chinese Boxing. Crit Chance is increased by 15%. Whenever Yan Qing deals damage with a Normal Attack, reduce his NP Cooldown by 1 Turns at the end of the Combat Process (2 Turns if ◈ is greater than 4).
In one line: Chinese boxing: crits more, and each hit readies his ultimate.
Lore: what it is: Chinese Boxing (EX): a martial art whose mastery aims at becoming one with the universe; he is believed to be the originator of many quan fa styles.
Icon concept: A boxer's open palm strike with a swirl of qi. A palm and a swirl. Teal and gold. Reads at 24px as: a palm with a swirl.

Name: Alter Ego
What it does (system): (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Outsider' Attribute and/or the 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill is increased by 50% including NP. All damage received from Units with the 'Outsider' Attribute and/or the 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill is reduced by 50% including NP.
In one line: An alter ego: deals more and takes more against outsider beings.
Lore: what it is: Alter Ego is a non-standard Extra Servant class made of beings split off from another, such as the Sakura Five and the Tamamo Nine.
Icon concept: A face split down the middle into two different masks. A divided oval. Violet and gold. Reads at 24px as: a split mask.

Name: Avenger
What it does (system): (Passive) All damage taken by this Servant is increased including NP. If this Servant Counters after receiving an Attack, the damage dealt when Countering is increased by the same amount including NP.
In one line: Takes more damage, but strikes back harder by the same amount.
Lore: what it is: Castor's skill symbolizing his vengeful desires against humans, held naturally as an Avenger.
Icon concept: A black flame rising from a broken chain. A flame over a gap. Black fire with a crimson edge. Reads at 24px as: a dark flame.

Name: Battle Continuation
Holders: Achilles, Cú Chulainn, Heracles, Vlad III (Berserker), Vlad III (Lancer)
What it does (system): (Passive 1) All damage received is reduced by the table roll; if NP, the number of dice rolled is doubled. (Passive 2) When this Unit is defeated, it is automatically revived. Requires the Unit's Health to have exceeded half its maximum at least once since the last activation.
In one line: Takes less damage, and once per stretch stands back up after being killed.
Lore: what it is: A Skill that lets a Servant keep fighting after mortal wounds and lowers the mortality of injuries; it reflects a vitality and refusal to give up.
Lore: how it looks: The wiki illustrates it with a user fighting on despite a fatal wound, with no fixed visual effect.
Icon concept: A warrior on one knee, leaning on a planted sword, still rising, with an ember glow at the wound. The kneeling-swordsman silhouette, backlit. Gold backlight on night. Reads at 24px as: a kneeling figure and a vertical blade.

Name: Bravery
What it does (system): (Passive) Chance of being inflicted with Mental Debuffs is reduced by 50%. (Active) Used during your Turn. Applies Atk Up (STR) for 1◈ Turns, STR damage dealt is increased by 25%; if NP, 15%.
In one line: Fearless: resists mind tricks and can boost physical damage.
Lore: what it is: Nullifies mental interference such as coercion, confusion and glamour, and raises melee damage.
Icon concept: A lion's face roaring in gold. A rounded mane shape. Ember gold. Reads at 24px as: a gold mane.

Name: Divinity
Rank: C / B / A / E- / EX / B+
Holders: Achilles, Arjuna, Chiron, Cú Chulainn, Heracles, Karna, Mannanán mac Lir, Medusa, Nemo, Ozymandias, Penthesilea, Proto Gil, Raikou, Rama, Semiramis, Tamamo, U-Olga Marie, Van Gogh
What it does (system): All damage dealt is increased by the table value, including NP.
In one line: Divine blood: every hit this unit lands is a little stronger.
Lore: what it is: A Skill measuring a Servant's aptitude as a Divine Spirit; high ranks make a demigod, and it falls as the Spirit's Monster or Demonic Beast nature rises.
Icon concept: A radiant sun disc with long, fine rays, a faint eye-shaped hollow at its core. A circle with rays. Pure white-gold on night, the brightest icon in the set. Reads at 24px as: a gold sun.

Name: Existence Outside The Domain
What it does (system): (Passive) Has the following effects on Van Gogh- 1. Chance of being inflicted by debuffs including Instakill is reduced by 25%, this effect is halved for Death (10%) and further halved for Erase (5%). 2. All damage received from Units with the 'Mad Enhancement' Skill is reduced by 40% including NP; all damage dealt to those Units is increased by 40% including NP. 3. All damage received from Units with the 'Existence Outside The Domain' Skill or the 'Outsider' Attribute is increased by 40% including NP. 4. Crit Chance is increased by 15%. 5. When a Unit with Active Mad Enhancement Attacks this Unit, the damage boosting effect of Mad Enhancement is negated. When this Unit Attacks a Unit with Active Mad Enhancement, the damage reducing effect of Mad Enhancement is negated.
In one line: From outside the world: resists curses and death, and takes less.
Lore: what it is: A class skill marking one descended from the outer realms of the Imaginary Void, possessed by an evil god and wielding a portent of its Authority.
Icon concept: An eye-shaped rift in space with tentacled stars behind it. An almond rift. Violet and black. Reads at 24px as: a violet rift.

Name: God's Resolution
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. Range=2. Used on an enemy Unit. Inflicts Stun for 1◈ Turns. Ignores Stun Resist, Stun Immune, and any other effects that specifically reduce the chance of being inflicted with Stun.
In one line: A divine judgement that stuns one foe, no matter their resistance.
Lore: what it is: Ruler class skill: a Ruler receives two Command Spells for every Servant in a Holy Grail War, but cannot repurpose Command Spells already used.
Icon concept: A crown-topped gavel striking a beam of light. A hammer and a burst. Gold and yellow shock. Reads at 24px as: a gavel strike.

Name: Independent Action with Viy
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Sustainability does not apply. (Passive 2) Master's ZON is increased by 3 panels. (Passive 3) Cannot be contracted by enemy Casters and Masters. (Passive 4) Crit Chance is increased by 10%. Crit Damage dealt is increased by 10%.
In one line: Viy acts for her: hard to steal, and her crits are keener.
Lore: what it is: A variation of Independent Action letting her act without a Master's mana supply, so long as Viy is near. She prefers to stay by her Master.
Icon concept: Base: the cloaked figure walking out of frame with a broken chain. Accent: a huge eye watches from the cloak. Reads at 24px as: a walking figure with an eye.

Name: Independent Action
Rank: A / B / A+ / C / EX / D
Holders: Arjuna, Chiron, EMIYA, Gray, Kingprotea, Kiritsugu, Medusa, Proto Gil, Hassan of Serenity, Sieg, Sita, U-Olga Marie
What it does (system): (Passive 1) Has a high Sustainability. (Passive 2) Master's ZON is increased by @rank's table value in panels. (Passive 3) Requires several successful 'Contract Servant' rolls to be contracted by enemy Masters and Casters; at A+ and EX, it cannot be contracted by an enemy at all.
In one line: Can act far from its Master and is hard for enemies to steal.
Lore: what it is: The ability to stay independent while rejecting the Master's mana supply, acting even without the Master; at higher ranks a Servant can linger without a contract.
Icon concept: A cloaked figure walking away out of frame, a broken chain trailing from one wrist. A striding silhouette with a loose line behind. Agility teal ground, bone ink figure. Reads at 24px as: a walking figure with a trailing line.

Name: Item Construction
Holders: Summer Habetrot, U-Olga Marie, Van Gogh
What it does (system): (Passive) Affects all allied Units within a 2 panel area of this Unit. 1. The chance of inflicting debuffs is increased by 35%; this effect is halved for Instakill (15%), and further halved for Death (5%). 2. The chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced by 35%; Instakill 15%, Death 5%. If a Unit is affected by multiple instances of this Skill, only the Item Construction with the highest Rank takes effect.
In one line: Allies nearby land curses more easily and shrug them off better.
Lore: what it is: A Caster-class Skill for manufacturing magical items, from implements of war to daily goods; it takes time to gather components and craft them.
Icon concept: A round alchemist's flask with a glowing liquid and a small gear stamped on the glass. A round-bottomed flask. Verdant liquid in smoked glass on violet night. Reads at 24px as: a round green flask.

Name: Mad Enhancement
Holders: Asterios, Castor, Gilles de Rais (Saber), Heracles, Kingprotea, Penthesilea, Raikou, Vlad III (Berserker)
What it does (system): (Active) While Active- 1. This Servant's Master loses Health at the end of every Turn it Acts; when the Master's Health is at or below that amount, Mad Enhancement is forcibly deactivated, and until it may be deactivated the Master's Health cannot drop below it in this way. 2. All damage taken is reduced; a smaller reduction applies to NP. 3. All damage dealt is increased including NP; halved for Base Attack (MAG). 4. MOV +2, Range +1, the Master's ZON +2. 5. Sustainability is reduced by 2◈ if its Master is defeated while Active. 6. This Servant can only Evade with Evade−. 7. The effects are neither a buff nor a debuff, and are Unremovable.
In one line: Goes berserk: tougher and fiercer, but it drains the Master each turn.
Lore: what it is: Berserker's Class Skill: it raises basic parameters and physical power in exchange for dulled reason, and may seal some Skills or Noble Phantasms.
Lore: how it looks: Users lose composed speech and thought, becoming aggressive or talking mostly to themselves.
Icon concept: A ring of fangs seen from inside a roaring maw, a single red eye glinting above. A ring of teeth. Bone white teeth, blood-brown ground, one crimson glint. Reads at 24px as: a ring of white teeth.

Name: Magic Resistance (weakness)
What it does (system): (Passive) Against MAG damage from an Attack that deals extra damage to @vsAttribute Units, Magic Resistance only negates damage from a MAG Rank of up to @rank, otherwise MAG damage taken is reduced by @percent%. Also affects NP.
In one line: Her magic resistance falters against attacks made to hunt her kind.
Lore: what it is: Magic Resistance is a skill that cancels spells and neutralizes grand sorceries below its rank, though divine mysteries and dragon-slaying sorcery can overwhelm it. The weakness variant is not on the page.
Icon concept: Base: the four-diamond ward rune. Accent: a crack running through one diamond. Reads at 24px as: a white cross with a crack.

Name: Magic Resistance
Holders: Achilles, Arjuna, Arturia, Chiron, Cú Chulainn, Francis Drake, EMIYA, Gilles de Rais (Saber), Gray, Karl de Große, Karna, Arturia (Lancer), Mannanán mac Lir, Medusa, Ozymandias, Pale Rider, Pollux, Proto Gil, Quetzalcoatl, Raikou, Rama, Scáthach, Sita, U-Olga Marie, Vlad III (Lancer)
What it does (system): (Passive 1) MAG damage from a MAG Rank of up to @rank is negated, otherwise MAG damage taken is reduced by the table value. Also affects NP. (Passive 2) Chance of being inflicted by debuffs is reduced. Also affects Instakill and Death UNLESS the source deals STR damage or is otherwise unaffected by Magic Resistance. Erase is completely unaffected.
In one line: Shrugs off magic: weak spells fail outright, strong ones hurt less, curses miss.
Lore: what it is: A Skill that protects against magical effects by cancelling spells outright, rather than merely rejecting mana; it is the Class Skill of Saber, Lancer, Archer, Rider and other classes.
Icon concept: A ward rune of four interlocked diamonds deflecting a scatter of spell sparks. A cross of diamonds. White lattice on a guard-blue vortex. Reads at 24px as: a white diamond cross.

Name: Oblivion Correction
What it does (system): (Passive) Crit Chance is increased.
In one line: Forgotten, he strikes where no one expects: more critical hits.
Lore: what it is: Zeus's divine blood was forgotten in later legends but kept in Castor's Saint Graph, so Castor never forgets he is a fallen god.
Icon concept: A blurred figure whose face is erased, a sharp star where the eyes should be. A faceless head with a spark. Grey and gold. Reads at 24px as: a blank head with a star.

Name: Presence Concealment
Holders: Hundred-Faced Hassan, Jack the Ripper, Katō Danzō, Kiritsugu, Semiramis, Hassan of Serenity, Yan Qing
What it does (system): (Active) Used during your Turn. The effects of this Skill last for 2◈ Turns. 1. This Unit cannot be targeted for an Attack or an enemy Unit's Skill. If it is caught in an AoE Attack and fails to Evade, Flip a Coin. If Heads, no damage and effects are received; if Tails, Total Damage taken from that Attack is reduced by 50% and PC is deactivated. 2. This Unit's Attacks cannot be Blocked or Countered unless the Defending Unit's current AGI Rank is equal to or higher than it. If the DU Evades, the Evade Roll is increased by the rank table value. 3. This Unit is able to Attack Masters and Move to any panel regardless of enemy Master-Servant positions. 4. All damage dealt is increased by 100%; if NP, 50%. Does not apply to Masters. 5. After performing an Attack while PC is Active, PC is deactivated at the end of the Combat Process. 6. When this Unit Moves into an enemy Servant's Range (or Detect), it has the rank table's chance of being discovered. 7. Active Skills targeting or affecting an enemy Unit cannot be used unless stated. Does not include Attack Skills and Spells that deal damage. 8. The effects of Presence Concealment are neither a buff nor a debuff, and are Unremovable. Cooldown: the rank table's value, counted from deactivation.
In one line: Vanishes from sight for two turns: enemies cannot target it.
Lore: what it is: The capacity to hide one's presence as a Servant, and the Assassin class's Class Skill.
Icon concept: A blank white mask dissolving into smoke, no features but two hollow eyes. An oval mask fading at its edges. Bone white in grey smoke on night. Reads at 24px as: a pale oval in dark smoke.

Name: Pretender: The One who Wears a Role
What it does (system): (Passive) All damage dealt to Units with the 'Alter-Ego' Skill is increased by 50% and all damage taken from them is reduced by 50%; applies to NP as well. All damage dealt to Units with the 'Outsider' Attribute and/or 'Existence Outside the Domain' Skill is reduced by 50% and all damage taken from them is increased by 50%; applies to NP as well. (Active) Used during your Turn. First, this Unit chooses a standard Servant Class. Apply the 'Pretender (>X)' effect to itself for 2◈ Turns, where X is the chosen Servant Class; its effects are as follows- All damage dealt to the selected Servant Class is increased by 50% and all damage taken from them is reduced by 50%; applies to NP as well. While this Unit has any 'Pretender' effect, the Passive effects of this Skill are negated. The 'Pretender' effect is neither a buff or a debuff and is Unremovable unless this Unit is inflicted with Skill Seal, then the 'Pretender' effect is removed from it. Cooldown: 4◈ Turns. Cannot be used if this Unit already has a 'Pretender' effect.
In one line: A role-wearer: strong against alter egos and certain others.
Lore: what it is: The Pretender class is made of those who became heroes while feigning another identity; the wiki page gives no skill text beyond the class concept.
Icon concept: A theatre mask held on a stick in front of a face. A mask on a stick. Gold and violet. Reads at 24px as: a mask on a stick.

Name: Riding
